            "areaPicturePath": "pipeline/publish/job-pipeline_WGS_CLINICAL-240403173500-14363864/ali-test-sz1-sycamore-test-WGS_CLINICAL-20240511720015760000009/output/24X040300008/CNV/ExonDepth/filter/chr8-145003272-145007519.html;NA;NA",

            "binEnd": 86190,

            "chr": "chr8",
            "chrCoord": "chr8:145003272-145007519",

            "areaPicturePath": "pipeline/publish/job-pipeline_WGS_CLINICAL-240403173500-14363864/ali-test-sz1-sycamore-test-WGS_CLINICAL-20240511720015760000009/output/24X040300008/CNV/ExonDepth/filter/chr16-203892-230580.html;NA;NA",
            "autoPm2": null,

            "binEnd": 140540,

            "chr": "chr16",
            "chrCoord": "chr16:203892-230580",
            "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"HBA1\", \"transcript\": \"NM_000558.3\", \"exon\": \"EX1-EX3E\", \"effecttype\": \"deletion\", \"chr\": \"16\", \"start\": \"203892\", \"stop\": \"230580\", \"primer\": \"HBA1;NM_000558.3;EX1-EX3E DEL;-;EX1-EX3E;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"141800\", \"location\": \"16p13.3\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"亨氏小体贫血症\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Heinz Body Anemias\", \"generalizationCn\": \"亨氏小体贫血症是一种非球形红细胞溶血性贫血的疾病。脾切除后，嗜碱性包涵体（也称为变性珠蛋白小体）在红细胞是明显可见。脾切除前，弥散性或者嗜碱性点状嗜碱粒细胞增多，该特征为血红蛋白病的表现。变性珠蛋白小体在无脾综合征（无脾伴有心血管异常）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶缺乏症中也有发现。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Form of non-spherocytic hemolytic anemia of Dacie type 1. After splenectomy, which has little benefit, basophilic inclusions called Heinz bodies are demonstrable in the erythrocytes. Before splenectomy, diffuse or punctate basophilia may be evident. Most of these cases are probably instances of hemoglobinopathy. The hemoglobin demonstrates heat lability. Heinz bodies are observed also with the Ivemark syndrome (asplenia with cardiovascular anomalies) and with glutathione peroxidase deficiency.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"140700\", \"omimGeneId\": \"141800\", \"systemSort\": \"血液病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AD\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"常染色体显性遗传;不耐热血红蛋白;脾切除术后红细胞中的亨氏小体;非球形红细胞性溶血性贫血\", \"ageOnset\": \"暂无\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"高铁血红蛋白血症α型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Methemoglobinemia, alpha type\", \"generalizationCn\": \"高铁血红蛋白血症α型是高铁血红蛋白血症的一种亚型。高铁血红蛋白血症是一种血液中超过1%的血红蛋白被氧化成高铁血红蛋白的临床疾病，高铁血红蛋白是一种含有铁（Fe3+）形式的血红蛋白。血红蛋白M的患者有紫绀，无其他方面的症状。如果突变发生在血红蛋白α亚单位，则在出生时明显发绀；如果β链受到影响，则发绀出现较晚或当β亚单位产生增加时症状加剧。新生儿携带胎儿M血红蛋白（γ亚单位），如发生γ-β完全转换时，紫绀症状可消失。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Methemoglobinemia is a clinical condition in which more than 1% of hemoglobin is oxidized to methemoglobin, a type of hemoglobin that contains the ferric (Fe3+) form of iron. Patients with hemoglobin M are cyanotic but otherwise asymptomatic. If the mutation occurs in the hemoglobin alpha subunit, cyanosis is apparent at birth, whereas if the beta chain (141900) is affected, cyanosis appears later or intensifies when beta subunit production increases. If a newborn carries a fetal M hemoglobin (gamma subunit; 142250), cyanosis disappears when the complete gamma-beta-switch occurs (summary by Mansouri and Lurie, 1993).(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"617973\", \"omimGeneId\": \"141800\", \"systemSort\": \"循环系统疾病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AD\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由血红蛋白 α 亚基 1 基因 (HBA1, 141800.0092) 突变引起;低氧亲和力血红蛋白;出生时发病;高铁血红蛋白血症;先天性慢性紫绀;常染色体显性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"暂无\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"红细胞增多症7型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Erythrocytosis 7\", \"generalizationCn\": \"家族性红细胞增多症7型的特征是血红蛋白(Hb)的氧亲和力增加，导致氧传递到外周组织的减少和代偿性红细胞增多症。患者一般无症状，因为代偿性红细胞增多保证正常的氧组织输送。患者红细胞形态正常。有报道指出，虽然高氧亲和力血红蛋白在年轻患者中通常耐受性良好，但在老年患者中或与增加血栓风险的其他原因相关，它们可导致血栓并发症。还指出，由α链变异体引起的Hb氧亲和力增加的影响通常比由β链变异体引起的影响更温和。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Familial erythrocytosis-7 is characterized by an increased oxygen affinity of hemoglobin (Hb), which results in decreased delivery of oxygen into the peripheral tissues and compensatory polycythemia.             "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"CCL3L1\", \"transcript\": \"NM_021006.4\", \"exon\": \"EX1-EX3E\", \"effecttype\": \"duplication\", \"chr\": \"17\", \"start\": \"34539179\", \"stop\": \"34625646\", \"primer\": \"CCL3L1;NM_021006.4;EX1-EX3E DUP;-;EX1-EX3E;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"601395\", \"location\": \"17q21.1\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"HIV-1病毒易感性\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"{HIV-1, susceptibility to}\", \"generalizationCn\": \"HIV是一种逐渐攻击人体免疫系统的病毒。由于免疫系统对疾病起自然防御的作用，因此艾滋病病毒感染者很难抵抗感染和疾病。HIV破坏白血细胞的辅助T淋巴细胞并使其在该淋巴细胞内进行复制。感染人体免疫缺陷病毒以及发展成艾滋病的发病机制有很大的个体差异性。病毒感染后，具有巨噬细胞（M）-和T淋巴细胞（T）-的热带菌株以及12个以上的亚型，可以生存在一系列的非特异性的、非遗传性的环境和不同的宿主环境。HIV-1，是全世界发现的最常见类型。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"HIV is a virus that gradually attacks the immune system, which is our body’s natural defence against illness.             "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"TSEN54\", \"transcript\": \"NM_207346.2\", \"exon\": \"EX1-EX2\", \"effecttype\": \"deletion\", \"chr\": \"17\", \"start\": \"73512643\", \"stop\": \"73512991\", \"primer\": \"TSEN54;NM_207346.2;EX1-EX2 DEL;-;EX1-EX2;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"608755\", \"location\": \"17q25.1\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"脑桥小脑发育不全5型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"?Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 5\", \"generalizationCn\": \"脑桥小脑发育不全5型（PCH5）是一种非常罕见的严重的脑桥小脑发育不全，产前发病，其特点是胎儿出现阵挛或癫痫样活动，并持续存在于婴儿期，并且小脑畸形导致产后早期死亡。脑桥小脑发育不全4型和5型在表型和基因型方面存在显着重叠，PCH5临床上类似于PCH4，其特征在于胎儿发作的阵挛或癫痫样发作，小头畸形，婴儿期持续存在小脑发育不全，和小脑畸形导致早期出生后死亡。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 5 (PCH5) is a very rare severe form of PCH (see this terme) with prenatal onset and characterized by fetal onset of clonus or seizures-like activity persisting in infancy and microencephaly leading to early postnatal death. There is significant overlap both in phenotype and in genotype between pontocerebellar hypoplasia types 4 and 5.PCH5, clinically resembling PCH4 (see this term), is characterized by fetal onset of clonus or seizure-like episodes, microcephaly, cerebellar hypoplasia persisting in infancy and microencephaly leading to early postnatal death.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"610204\", \"omimGeneId\": \"608755\", \"systemSort\": \"神经肌肉系统疾病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AR\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由 tRNA 剪接核酸内切酶亚基 54 基因 (TSEN54, 608755.0001) 突变引起;据报道有一个家庭（最后一次策划于 2015 年 2 月）;新生儿期死亡;子宫内发病;小脑细胞缺乏，蚓部比半球更明显;齿状核缺失或未成熟;发育不良的C形下橄榄核;妊娠 18 周左右开始在子宫内癫痫发作，包括类似癫痫发作的活动;橄榄脑桥小脑发育不全，严重;小脑发育不全;小头畸形;常染色体隐性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"胎儿期发病\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"脑桥小脑发育不全4型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 4\", \"generalizationCn\": \"脑桥小脑发育不全4型（PCH4）是一种非常罕见的PCH形式，其特征是产前发生羊水过多和挛缩，其次是肌张力过高，严重的阵挛，原发性通气不足导致产后早期死亡。PCH4的产前特征是羊水过多。新生儿出现小头畸形，中枢性呼吸暂停需要呼吸支持，畸形（前额倾斜，面中部发育不全，小颌畸形），挛缩（50％）“关节挛缩”，严重的阵挛和肌张力过高。PCH4受影响的婴儿通常不会活到新生儿期以后。从机械通气到脱机很困难，通常都会失败。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 4 (PCH4) is a very rare form of PCH (see this term), characterized by prenatal onset of polyhydramnios and contractures followed by hypertonia, severe clonus, primary hypoventilation leading to an early postnatal death.PCH4 is characterized prenatally by polyhydramnios. Neonates present with microcephaly, central apnea requiring respiratory support, dysmorphism (sloping forehead, midface hypoplasia, micrognathia), contractures (50%) ''arthrogryposis'', severe clonus,and hypertonia. PCH4 affected babies usually do not live beyond the neonatal period. Weaning from mechanical ventilation is difficult and usually fails.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"225753\", \"omimGeneId\": \"608755\", \"systemSort\": \"神经肌肉系统疾病、产前发育或分娩异常\", \"heredityModel\": \"AR\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由 tRNA 剪接核酸内切酶亚基 54 基因 (TSEN54, 608755.0001) 突变引起;死亡通常在婴儿期;出生时发病;羊水过多;新皮质萎缩;下橄榄核呈胎儿型;下橄榄核萎缩;脑干发育不全;脑桥发育不全;浦肯野细胞丢失;小脑皮质显示正常层;小脑叶减少;小脑发育不全;肌阵挛;痉挛;癫痫发作;精神运动发育迟缓，深刻;出生时张力亢进;先天性挛缩;吞咽障碍;中枢性呼吸衰竭;少量自主呼吸;小头畸形;常染色体隐性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"出生时发病\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"脑桥小脑发育不全2A型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2A\", \"generalizationCn\": \"脑桥小脑发育不全2型（PCH2）是最常见的脑桥小脑发育不全的亚型，其特征是新生儿发病和缺乏自主运动发育和随后的进行性微脑畸形，全身性阵挛，舞蹈病和痉挛。大多数患者不会进入青春期。在怀孕平稳且没有畸形特征的情况下，受影响的新生儿通常但不总是出现由于吞咽不协调导致的吞咽困难，呼吸和进食困难以及全身性阵挛。伴有混合性痉挛的锥体外系运动障碍如舞蹈病，手足徐动症和肌张力障碍后期发展。从婴儿期开始，受影响的儿童发展为进行性小脑畸形，中央视力损害，癫痫发作以及认知和运动发育的严重损害，其特征是身体运动发育受损，头部控制失败，缺乏自主性手控制以及言语和交流缺失。PCH2在儿童早期通常是致命的。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2 (PCH2) is the most common subtype of pontocerebellar hypoplasia characterized by neonatal onset and a lack of voluntary motor development and later progressive microencephaly, generalized clonus, development of chorea and spasticity. The majority of patients will not reach puberty. After an uneventful pregnancy and birth without dysmorphic features, affected neonates present usually, but not always, with dysphagia due to bucco-pharyngeal incoordination, respiratory and feeding difficulties and generalized clonus.             "generalizationCn": "脑桥小脑发育不全5型（PCH5）是一种非常罕见的严重的脑桥小脑发育不全，产前发病，其特点是胎儿出现阵挛或癫痫样活动，并持续存在于婴儿期，并且小脑畸形导致产后早期死亡。脑桥小脑发育不全4型和5型在表型和基因型方面存在显着重叠，PCH5临床上类似于PCH4，其特征在于胎儿发作的阵挛或癫痫样发作，小头畸形，婴儿期持续存在小脑发育不全，和小脑畸形导致早期出生后死亡。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>脑桥小脑发育不全4型（PCH4）是一种非常罕见的PCH形式，其特征是产前发生羊水过多和挛缩，其次是肌张力过高，严重的阵挛，原发性通气不足导致产后早期死亡。PCH4的产前特征是羊水过多。新生儿出现小头畸形，中枢性呼吸暂停需要呼吸支持，畸形（前额倾斜，面中部发育不全，小颌畸形），挛缩（50％）“关节挛缩”，严重的阵挛和肌张力过高。PCH4受影响的婴儿通常不会活到新生儿期以后。从机械通气到脱机很困难，通常都会失败。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>脑桥小脑发育不全2型（PCH2）是最常见的脑桥小脑发育不全的亚型，其特征是新生儿发病和缺乏自主运动发育和随后的进行性微脑畸形，全身性阵挛，舞蹈病和痉挛。大多数患者不会进入青春期。在怀孕平稳且没有畸形特征的情况下，受影响的新生儿通常但不总是出现由于吞咽不协调导致的吞咽困难，呼吸和进食困难以及全身性阵挛。伴有混合性痉挛的锥体外系运动障碍如舞蹈病，手足徐动症和肌张力障碍后期发展。从婴儿期开始，受影响的儿童发展为进行性小脑畸形，中央视力损害，癫痫发作以及认知和运动发育的严重损害，其特征是身体运动发育受损，头部控制失败，缺乏自主性手控制以及言语和交流缺失。PCH2在儿童早期通常是致命的。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>新生儿期出现吮吸和吞咽不协调；严重发育迟缓；锥体束外症状；舞蹈症；肌张力障碍；羊水过多（参考来源：OMIM;PMID33111306）",
            "generalizationEn": "Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 5 (PCH5) is a very rare severe form of PCH (see this terme) with prenatal onset and characterized by fetal onset of clonus or seizures-like activity persisting in infancy and microencephaly leading to early postnatal death. There is significant overlap both in phenotype and in genotype between pontocerebellar hypoplasia types 4 and 5.PCH5, clinically resembling PCH4 (see this term), is characterized by fetal onset of clonus or seizure-like episodes, microcephaly, cerebellar hypoplasia persisting in infancy and microencephaly leading to early postnatal death.(Source:OMIM)<br>Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 4 (PCH4) is a very rare form of PCH (see this term), characterized by prenatal onset of polyhydramnios and contractures followed by hypertonia, severe clonus, primary hypoventilation leading to an early postnatal death.PCH4 is characterized prenatally by polyhydramnios. Neonates present with microcephaly, central apnea requiring respiratory support, dysmorphism (sloping forehead, midface hypoplasia, micrognathia), contractures (50%) ''arthrogryposis'', severe clonus,and hypertonia. PCH4 affected babies usually do not live beyond the neonatal period. Weaning from mechanical ventilation is difficult and usually fails.(Source:OMIM)<br>Pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2 (PCH2) is the most common subtype of pontocerebellar hypoplasia characterized by neonatal onset and a lack of voluntary motor development and later progressive microencephaly, generalized clonus, development of chorea and spasticity. The majority of patients will not reach puberty. After an uneventful pregnancy and birth without dysmorphic features, affected neonates present usually, but not always, with dysphagia due to bucco-pharyngeal incoordination, respiratory and feeding difficulties and generalized clonus. Extrapyramidal dyskinesia with mixed spasticity such as chorea, athetosis and dystonia develop later. From infancy onward, affected children develop progressive microencephaly, central visual impairment, seizures and a severe impairment of cognitive and motor development, marked by an impaired statural motor development with failing head control, lack of voluntary hand control and the absence of speech and communication. \"generalizationEn\": \"Peutz-Jeghers syndrome is an autosomal dominant disorder characterized by melanocytic macules of the lips, buccal mucosa, and digits; multiple gastrointestinal hamartomatous             "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"SERPINA1\", \"transcript\": \"NM_000295.4\", \"exon\": \"EX4-EX5E\", \"effecttype\": \"duplication\", \"chr\": \"14\", \"start\": \"94830102\", \"stop\": \"94846675\", \"primer\": \"SERPINA1;NM_000295.4;EX4-EX5E DUP;-;EX4-EX5E;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"107400\", \"location\": \"14q32.13\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"α1抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Alpha1-Antitrypsin Deficiency\", \"generalizationCn\": \"α1抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症（AATD）的临床特征是成年人患慢性阻塞性肺疾病（例如肺气肿、持续的气流阻塞或慢性支气管炎）的风险增加，儿童和成年时期患肝脏疾病、脂膜炎和c-ANCA血管炎的风险增加。患者常表现为肺气肿、支气管扩张。肺气肿在儿童AATD患者中极其罕见，只有一小部分儿童患者患有AATD相关的肝病，在出生几个月时表现为阻塞性黄疸和增加血清转氨酶水平。肝脏疾病的发病率随着年龄的增长而增加。AATD患者患肝细胞癌（HCC）的风险增加。慢性阻塞性肺病患者采用标准治疗法。气流阻塞患者建议采用静脉增强疗法。肺部疾病晚期患者需要肺移植。脂肪炎的疼痛结节病变可能自行消退，也可能在服用大黄素或多西环素治疗后消退，当对常规治疗无反应时，脂肪炎已经对高于常规剂量的静脉增强疗法有反应。发病率为1/1,500-1/3,500（欧洲）。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD) is characterized by an increased risk for: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (i.e., emphysema, persistent airflow obstruction, and/or chronic bronchitis) in adults; liver disease in children and adults; panniculitis ; and c-ANCA positive vasculitis. Emphysema, sometimes with associated bronchiectasis, is the most common manifestation of AATD.Although reported, emphysema in children with AATD is extremely rare. AATD-associated liver disease, which is present in only a small portion of affected children, manifests as obstructive jaundice and increased serum aminotransferase levels in the early days and months of life. The incidence of liver disease increases with age.The risk for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is increased in individuals with AATD. Treatment of manifestations: COPD is treated with standard therapy. Intravenous augmentation therapy (regular infusion of purified human AAT to elevate deficient serum AAT concentrations) has been recommended for individuals with established fixed airflow obstruction. Lung transplantation may be an appropriate option for individuals with end-stage lung disease. Liver transplantation is the definitive treatment for advanced liver disease. The often painful nodular lesions of panniculitis may resolve spontaneously or after dapsone or doxycycline therapy. When refractory to conventional treatment, panniculitis has responded to intravenous AAT augmentation therapy in higher than conventional doses.Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency occurs worldwide, but its prevalence varies by population. People with hypercholesterolemia have a high risk of developing a form of heart disease called coronary artery disease. This condition occurs when excess cholesterol in the bloodstream is deposited in the walls of blood vessels, particularly in the arteries that supply blood to the heart (coronary arteries). The abnormal buildup of cholesterol forms clumps (plaque) that narrow and harden artery walls. As the clumps get bigger, they can clog the arteries and restrict the flow of blood to the heart. The buildup of plaque in coronary arteries causes a form of chest pain called angina and greatly increases a person's risk of having a heart attack. Inherited forms of hypercholesterolemia can also cause health problems related to the buildup of excess cholesterol in other tissues. If cholesterol accumulates in tendons, it causes characteristic growths called tendon xanthomas. These growths most often affect the Achilles tendons and tendons in the hands and fingers. Yellowish cholesterol deposits under the skin of the eyelids are known as xanthelasmata. Cholesterol can also accumulate at the edges of the clear, front surface of the eye (the cornea), leading to a gray-colored ring called an arcus cornealis. More than 34 million American adults have elevated blood cholesterol levels (higher than 240 mg/dL). Inherited forms of hypercholesterolemia, which cause even higher levels of cholesterol, occur less frequently. The most common inherited form of high cholesterol is called familial hypercholesterolemia. Recommendations for both primary prevention and secondary prevention have been published. For those at high risk a combination of lifestyle modification and statins has been shown to decrease mortality. This condition affects about 1 in 500 people in most countries.             "generalizationCn": "垂体性侏儒症II型是一种严重的生长激素不敏感性疾病，主要临床表现包括生长缺陷、身材矮小、生长激素受体功能障碍和在生长因子应答方面无法产生胰岛素样生长因子I。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>生长激素反应性增强与GHR 部分缺乏引起的身材矮小相关。GHR 部分缺乏引起的身材矮小是一种罕见的遗传性内分泌疾病，其特征是由于 GHR 功能减弱（配体结合减少或受体可用性降低）导致特发性身材矮小，从而导致对生长激素部分不敏感。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>部分生长激素不敏感是一种因生长激素部分抵抗而导致身材矮小的疾病。身材矮小是指比同龄、同性别、营养良好、健康的人群的平均身高低2个标准差以上（或低于2.5个百分数）。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>高胆固醇血症是一种以血液中胆固醇含量极高为特征的疾病。胆固醇是体内产生的一种来源于动物（特别是蛋黄、肉类、家禽、鱼和乳制品等）的蜡状、油脂状物质。人体需要这种物质来构建细胞膜、合成激素以及帮助消化脂肪的物质。但是胆固醇过多的话会增加患心脏疾病的风险。高胆固醇血症患者是冠状动脉疾病的高发人群，当血液中多余的胆固醇沉积在血管壁（尤其是冠状动脉）时容易发病。胆固醇凝块的异常堆积会导致动脉壁的狭窄和硬化。凝块的进一步加大可能会阻塞动脉，限制血液流向心脏。凝块在冠状动脉的堆积会引起心绞痛，大大增加了心脏病风险。遗传性的高胆固醇血症还会导致其他组织中胆固醇的过量积累。胆固醇积聚在肌腱会导致肌腱黄色瘤，从而影响跟腱以及手和手指的肌腱。胆固醇也可以积累在眼睛导致角膜炎。超过3400万美国成年人胆固醇含量升高（高于240 mg/dL）。关于高胆固醇血症的一级预防和二级预防已经公布，对于高风险患者，改变生活方式和他汀类药物的结合治疗被证明可以降低死亡率。遗传性高胆固醇血症发生频率较低，大多数国家的发病率为1/500。在南非白人、法裔加拿大人、黎巴嫩人以及芬兰人中较为常见。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "A severe form of growth hormone insensitivity characterized by growth impairment, short stature, dysfunctional growth hormone receptor, and failure to generate insulin-like growth factor I in response to growth hormone.(Source:OMIM)<br>Short stature due to partial GHR deficiency is a rare, genetic, endocrine disease characterized by idiopathic short stature due to diminished GHR function (decreased ligand binding or reduced availability of receptor), thus resulting in partial insensitivity to growth hormone.(Source:OMIM)<br>A disease characterized by partial resistance to growth hormone resulting in short stature. Short stature is defined by a standing height more than 2 standard deviations below the mean (or below the 2.5 percentile) for sex and chronological age, compared with a well-nourished, healthy, genetically relevant population.(Source:OMIM)<br>Hypercholesterolemia is a condition characterized by very high levels of cholesterol in the blood. People with hypercholesterolemia have a high risk of developing a form of heart disease called coronary artery disease. This condition occurs when excess cholesterol in the bloodstream is deposited in the walls of blood vessels, particularly in the arteries that supply blood to the heart (coronary arteries). The abnormal buildup of cholesterol forms clumps (plaque) that narrow and harden artery walls. As the clumps get bigger, they can clog the arteries and restrict the flow of blood to the heart. The buildup of plaque in coronary arteries causes a form of chest pain called angina and greatly increases a person's risk of having a heart attack. Inherited forms of hypercholesterolemia can also cause health problems related to the buildup of excess cholesterol in other tissues. If cholesterol accumulates in tendons, it causes characteristic growths called tendon xanthomas. These growths most often affect the Achilles tendons and tendons in the hands and fingers. Yellowish cholesterol deposits under the skin of the eyelids are known as xanthelasmata. Cholesterol can also accumulate at the edges of the clear, front surface of the eye (the cornea), leading to a gray-colored ring called an arcus cornealis. More than 34 million American adults have elevated blood cholesterol levels (higher than 240 mg/dL). Inherited forms of hypercholesterolemia, which cause even higher levels of cholesterol, occur less frequently. The most common inherited form of high cholesterol is called familial hypercholesterolemia. Recommendations for both primary prevention and secondary prevention have been published. For those at high risk a combination of lifestyle modification and statins has been shown to decrease mortality. This condition affects about 1 in 500 people in most countries. Familial hypercholesterolemia occurs more frequently in certain populations, including Afrikaners in South Africa, French Canadians, Lebanese, and Finns.(Source:OMIM)",

It has intermediate severity, with onset between 6 and 18 months. Patients do not reach the motor milestone of standing, and survive into adulthood.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"253550\", \"omimGeneId\": \"600354\", \"systemSort\": \"神经肌肉系统疾病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AR\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由SMN1基因 (SMN1, 600354.0002) 存活突变引起;在 18% 的 SMAII 患者中发现 NAIP 基因 (600355) 缺失;孩子经常可以无支撑地坐着，但从不走动;呼吸道感染或衰竭继发死亡;2岁至青年期死亡;6-18 个月的显现;手部震颤;前角细胞变性;舌颤/颤动;肌电图显示神经源性异常;肌肉萎缩;由于运动神经元病，肌肉无力，对称，近端（下肢比上肢受影响更大）;常染色体隐性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"婴幼儿期，新生儿期\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"脊髓性肌萎缩症I型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Spinal Muscular Atrophy, Type I\", \"generalizationCn\": \"脊髓性肌萎缩症I型是脊髓性肌萎缩症的一种亚型。脊髓性肌萎缩症是一种神经肌肉疾病，其特征是由脊髓前角细胞变性导致的对称性肌无力和肌萎缩。常染色体隐性遗传的亚型根据发病年龄、肌无力的严重程度和存活时间来划分。该病的严重程度主要由SMN2的拷贝数决定，会产生缺失7号外显子的转录本，使编码与SMN1相同蛋白的完整转录本的数量降低。只有约4％脊髓性肌萎缩症患者携带一个SMN1拷贝且有一个基因内突变。脊髓性肌萎缩症I型是一种严重的亚型，在出生后的6个月内发病，而且永远不会坐。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"A form of spinal muscular atrophy, a group of neuromuscular disorder characterized by degeneration of the anterior horn cells of the spinal cord, leading to symmetrical muscle weakness and atrophy. Autosomal recessive forms are classified according to the age of onset, the maximum muscular activity achieved, and survivorship. The severity of the disease is mainly determined by the copy number of SMN2, a copy gene which predominantly produces exon 7-skipped transcripts and only low amount of full-length transcripts that encode for a protein identical to SMN1. Only about 4% of SMA patients bear one SMN1 copy with an intragenic mutation. SMA1 is a severe form, with onset before 6 months of age.             "aliasEn": "C4A DEFICIENCY<br>CHIDO/RODGERS BLOOD GROUP SYSTEM",
            "areaPicturePath": "NA;pipeline/publish/job-pipeline_WGS_CLINICAL-240403173501-14363865/ali-test-sz1-sycamore-test-WGS_CLINICAL-20240511702031870000004/output/24X040300009/CNV/ExonDepth/filter/chr6-31961694-31963571.html;NA",

            "bayesian": "NA;8.07;NA",
            "binEnd": 63730,
            "binStart": 63724,
            "chr": "chr6",
            "chrCoord": "chr6:31961694-31963571",
            "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"C4A\", \"transcript\": \"NM_007293.2\", \"exon\": \"EX19-EX25\", \"effecttype\": \"deletion\", \"chr\": \"6\", \"start\": \"31961694\", \"stop\": \"31963571\", \"primer\": \"C4A;NM_007293.2;EX19-EX25 DEL;-;EX19-EX25;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"120810\", \"location\": \"6p21.33\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"补体C4A缺乏症\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Complement Component 4A Deficiency\", \"generalizationCn\": \"补体C4A缺乏症是一种罕见的补体经典途径缺陷而导致的免疫性疾病，表现为自身免疫性疾病、系统性红斑狼疮伴（或不伴）肾小球肾炎。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"A rare defect of the complement classical pathway associated with the development of autoimmune disorders, mainly systemic lupus with or without associated glomerulonephritis.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"614380\", \"omimGeneId\": \"120810\", \"systemSort\": \"免疫及感染类疾病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AR\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由补体成分 4A 基因 (C4A, 120810.0001) 突变引起;SLE患者中纯合子个体c4A缺乏症的患病率比一般人群高10-15x;完全 C4 缺乏的患者是双无效 C4 单倍型的纯合子;C4、C4A (120810) 和 C4B (120820) 的两个基因座控制合成;在完全 C4 缺乏症中缺乏 CH50 活性;血管炎;过敏性紫癜;皮肌炎;系统性红斑狼疮;光敏皮疹;肾小球肾炎;常染色体隐性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"暂无发病年龄\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"Rodgers血型系统\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"[Blood group, Rodgers]\", \"generalizationCn\": \"Chido和Rodgers血型系统是C4蛋白抗原表位，这些抗原表位和多态性在病人输血中可能导致Ch或Rg抗原抗体的形成。抗Ch和抗Rg的识别依赖于抗体与Ch-positive 或 Rg-positive个体的中和反应以及与合适的Ch-negative或Rg-negative红细胞缺乏反应性。C4蛋白以两种形式存在:C4A和C4B，是由密切相连的两个基因编码的。C4A和C4B的单链前体均为1744个几乎完全相同的氨基酸，只是在1101-1106位有区别。C4A和C4B通常是通过表达ch抗原或者是Rg抗原来进行区分识别，该抗原是在1188到1191残基位置，Ch1抗原决定表位有ADLR以及Rg1抗原决定表位有VDLL。虽然在某些单倍体型中这种关系可能会被交换，但是C4A蛋白通常携带Rg抗原，C4B抗原通常携带Ch抗原。Ch/Rg系统已经识别了9个抗原：6个高频Ch，2个高频Rg，一个低频WH。已经确立Ch/Rg系统8种表型，有88.2%的个体有Ch(1,2,3)血型抗体表型以及95%的个体有Rg(1,2)血型抗体表型。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"The blood groups Chido (Ch) and Rodgers (Rg) are epitopes on the C4 protein, and polymorphisms associated with these epitopes may lead to the formation of antibodies to the Ch or Rg antigens in transfused patients. Identification of anti-Ch or anti-Rg is based on antibody neutralization with plasma from Ch-positive or Rg-positive individuals and lack of reactivity with qualified Ch-negative or Rg-negative red blood cells. The C4 protein occurs in 2 forms, C4A and C4B, which are encoded by 2 closely linked genes. C4A and C4B are expressed as single-chain precursors of 1,744 amino acids that are nearly identical, with amino acids differences at residues 1101 to 1106 distinguishing C4A from C4B. C4A and C4B are also distinguished by their expression of either the Ch antigen or the Rg antigen at residues 1188 to 1191, where the Ch1 epitope has ADLR and the Rg1 epitope has VDLL. C4A proteins usually carry the Rg antigens, and C4B proteins usually carry the Ch antigens, although in some haplotypes these associations are switched. Nine antigens have been described for the Ch/Rg system: 6 of high prevalence for Ch, 2 of high prevalence for Rg, and 1 of low prevalence, WH.             "generalizationCn": "补体C4A缺乏症是一种罕见的补体经典途径缺陷而导致的免疫性疾病，表现为自身免疫性疾病、系统性红斑狼疮伴（或不伴）肾小球肾炎。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Chido和Rodgers血型系统是C4蛋白抗原表位，这些抗原表位和多态性在病人输血中可能导致Ch或Rg抗原抗体的形成。抗Ch和抗Rg的识别依赖于抗体与Ch-positive 或 Rg-positive个体的中和反应以及与合适的Ch-negative或Rg-negative红细胞缺乏反应性。C4蛋白以两种形式存在:C4A和C4B，是由密切相连的两个基因编码的。C4A和C4B的单链前体均为1744个几乎完全相同的氨基酸，只是在1101-1106位有区别。C4A和C4B通常是通过表达ch抗原或者是Rg抗原来进行区分识别，该抗原是在1188到1191残基位置，Ch1抗原决定表位有ADLR以及Rg1抗原决定表位有VDLL。虽然在某些单倍体型中这种关系可能会被交换，但是C4A蛋白通常携带Rg抗原，C4B抗原通常携带Ch抗原。Ch/Rg系统已经识别了9个抗原：6个高频Ch，2个高频Rg，一个低频WH。已经确立Ch/Rg系统8种表型，有88.2%的个体有Ch(1,2,3)血型抗体表型以及95%的个体有Rg(1,2)血型抗体表型。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "A rare defect of the complement classical pathway associated with the development of autoimmune disorders, mainly systemic lupus with or without associated glomerulonephritis.(Source:OMIM)<br>The blood groups Chido (Ch) and Rodgers (Rg) are epitopes on the C4 protein, and polymorphisms associated with these epitopes may lead to the formation of antibodies to the Ch or Rg antigens in transfused patients. Identification of anti-Ch or anti-Rg is based on antibody neutralization with plasma from Ch-positive or Rg-positive individuals and lack of reactivity with qualified Ch-negative or Rg-negative red blood cells. The C4 protein occurs in 2 forms, C4A and C4B, which are encoded by 2 closely linked genes. C4A and C4B are expressed as single-chain precursors of 1,744 amino acids that are nearly identical, with amino acids differences at residues 1101 to 1106 distinguishing C4A from C4B. C4A and C4B are also distinguished by their expression of either the Ch antigen or the Rg antigen at residues 1188 to 1191, where the Ch1 epitope has ADLR and the Rg1 epitope has VDLL. C4A proteins usually carry the Rg antigens, and C4B proteins usually carry the Ch antigens, although in some haplotypes these associations are switched. Nine antigens have been described for the Ch/Rg system: 6 of high prevalence for Ch, 2 of high prevalence for Rg, and 1 of low prevalence, WH. Eight phenotypes of the Ch/Rg system have been established, with 88.2% of individuals having the Ch(1,2,3) Chido phenotype and 95.0% of individuals having the Rg(1,2) Rodgers phenotype (review by {6:Mougey (2010)}).(Source:OMIM)",

            "generalizationCn": "先天性肾上腺皮质增生症（CAH）是由于肾上腺皮质激素生物合成酶系中某种或数种酶的先天性缺陷，使皮质醇等激素水平改变所致的一组遗传代谢性疾病。先天性肾上腺皮质增生症最常见的是21-羟化酶缺陷症（21-OHD），约占90%~95%。21-OHD CAH患者具有女性男性化和男性性早熟的临床表现，部分患者还表现出呕吐、低钠血症、脱水等。经典型患者酶缺陷严重，发病年龄早；非经典型21-OHD CAH患者具有轻中度的酶缺陷，发病年龄较晚，可出现多毛、痤疮和月经紊乱等雄激素过多的表现。21-OHD CAH呈常染色体隐性遗传，是由CYP21A2基因缺陷引起。21-OHD CAH的发病率为1/15000新生儿。其中，约有1%的变异为de novo。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>先天性肾上腺皮质增生症（CAH）是由于肾上腺皮质激素生物合成酶系中某种或数种酶的先天性缺陷，使皮质醇等激素水平改变所致的一组遗传代谢性疾病。先天性肾上腺皮质增生症最常见的是21-羟化酶缺陷症（21-OHD），约占90%~95%。21-OHD CAH患者具有女性男性化和男性性早熟的临床表现，部分患者还表现出呕吐、低钠血症、脱水等。经典型患者酶缺陷严重，发病年龄早；非经典型21-OHD CAH患者具有轻中度的酶缺陷，发病年龄较晚，可出现多毛、痤疮和月经紊乱等雄激素过多的表现。21-OHD CAH呈常染色体隐性遗传，是由CYP21A2基因缺陷引起。21-OHD CAH的发病率为1/15000新生儿。其中，约有1%的变异为de novo。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>胎儿水肿；肾上腺增大；身体轻度水肿；NT增厚（参考来源：PMID15027021;PMID11288125）<br>Tenascin-X缺乏型Ehlers-Danlos综合征是一种结缔组织疾病，该疾病的临床表现为皮肤过度伸展、关节活动过度和组织脆弱。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>膀胱输尿管返流8型是膀胱输尿管返流的一种亚型。膀胱输尿管返流是一种先天性肾脏及泌尿道异常疾病，主要特点为尿液从膀胱中反流回输尿管甚至肾脏中，增大尿道感染风险。本病是由输尿管膀胱连接点发育缺陷引起的。膀胱输尿管返流结合肾内反流导致的炎症反应可能会引起肾损伤或肾结瘢，即反流性肾病。广泛性的肾结瘢会损害肾功能，从而使患者发生高血压、蛋白尿、肾功能不全和晚期肾疾病。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "21-hydroxylase deficiency (21-OHD) is the most common cause of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH), a family of autosomal recessive disorders involving impaired synthesis of cortisol from cholesterol by the adrenal cortex. In 21-OHD CAH, excessive adrenal androgen biosynthesis results in virilization in all individuals and salt wasting in some individuals. A classic form with severe enzyme deficiency and prenatal onset of virilization is distinguished from a non-classic form with mild enzyme deficiency and postnatal onset. Newborns with salt-wasting 21-OHD CAH are at risk for life-threatening salt-wasting crises. CYP21A2 is the only gene in which mutations are known to cause 21-OHD CAH. Approximately 1% of mutations occur de novo.             "generalizationCn": "Sponastrime型脊椎干骺端发育不良是一种常染色体隐性遗传性脊椎干骺端发育不良（SEMD），以特征性的临床和影像学发现而命名，包括脊柱（脊椎）异常、面中部发育不全伴鼻梁凹陷和干骺端条纹。其他特征还包括不成比例的身材矮小伴明显的腰椎前凸、脊柱侧弯、髋内翻、肘关节伸展受限、骨骺发育不良、儿童白内障、牙根短以及低丙种球蛋白血症。影像学上，腰椎椎体异常被认为是最具特征性的表型，因为特征性干骺端条纹可能在年轻时不明显。不同个体在表现、严重程度和相关特征方面差异较大。（参考来源：OMIM）",

            "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"PLP1\", \"transcript\": \"NM_000533.3\", \"exon\": \"EX1-EX7E\", \"effecttype\": \"duplication\", \"chr\": \"X\", \"start\": \"102841605\", \"stop\": \"103080714\", \"primer\": \"PLP1;NM_000533.3;EX1-EX7E DUP;-;EX1-EX7E;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"300401\", \"location\": \"Xq22.2\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"佩梅病\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease\", \"generalizationCn\": \"佩梅病又称低髓鞘化脑白质营养不良1型，是一种罕见的脑与脊髓（中枢神经系统）疾病，是脑白质营养性障碍的一种。佩梅病是髓鞘形成障碍导致的。佩梅病患者智力受损（语言能力、记忆能力）及运功能力发育迟缓（协调性和行走能力）。患者运动能力受影响程度比智力更大；运动能力发育缓慢且通常在青春期停止发育，之后逐渐退化。佩酶病依据病情严重性可分为经典型和先天型，两型有一些相同的特征。经典型佩梅病是较常见的一型。患者一岁以内会出现肌张力减退、眼球震颤及运动能力发育迟缓的症状。随着年龄增长，患者眼球震颤症状会停止但其他特征会恶化，包括痉挛、共济失调和舞蹈病样运动。先天型佩梅病病情相对严重。患者婴儿期发病，病症包括喂养困难、呼吸时有口哨声、进行性痉挛导致的关节挛缩、构音障碍、共济失调和癫痫。先天性佩梅病患者在运动能力和智力方面几乎没有发育。佩梅病患者需要一个多学科团队为其提供治疗，包括神经科、物理理疗、整形外科、肺内科及肠胃病相关医护人员。患者有严重的吞咽困难症状时需做胃造口手术。患者需使用抗癫痫药物治疗癫痫，用常规的治疗手段治疗痉挛包括物理疗法、锻炼、药物治疗（巴氯芬、替扎尼定、地西泮、肉毒杆菌毒素），有关节挛缩的患者还需做整形外科手术。佩梅病在美国男性人群的发病率为1/500000到1/200000之间，女性佩梅病患者很罕见。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is an inherited condition involving the brain and spinal cord (central nervous system) and one of a group of genetic disorders called leukodystrophies. Individuals with this condition have impaired intellectual functions and delayed motor skills. Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is divided into classic and connatal types, different in severity. Classic Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is the more common type. Within the first year of life, those affected with classic Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease typically experience hypotonia, nystagmus, and delayed development of motor skills. As the child gets older, nystagmus usually stops but other movement disorders develop, including spasticity, ataxia, and choreiform movements. The symptoms of connatal Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease can begin in infancy and include problems feeding, a whistling sound when breathing, progressive spasticity leading to contractures that restrict movement, dysarthria, ataxia, and seizures. A multidisciplinary team comprising specialists in neurology, physical medicine, orthopedics, pulmonary medicine, and gastroenterology should be assembled. Treatment may include gastrostomy for individuals with severe dysphagia; antiepileptic drugs (AEDs) for seizures; and routine management of spasticity including physical therapy, exercise, medications (baclofen, diazepam, tizanidine, botulinum toxin), orthotics, and surgery for joint contractures. The prevalence of Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is estimated to be 1 in 200,000 to 500,000 males in the United States.             "generalizationCn": "佩梅病又称低髓鞘化脑白质营养不良1型，是一种罕见的脑与脊髓（中枢神经系统）疾病，是脑白质营养性障碍的一种。佩梅病是髓鞘形成障碍导致的。佩梅病患者智力受损（语言能力、记忆能力）及运功能力发育迟缓（协调性和行走能力）。患者运动能力受影响程度比智力更大；运动能力发育缓慢且通常在青春期停止发育，之后逐渐退化。佩酶病依据病情严重性可分为经典型和先天型，两型有一些相同的特征。经典型佩梅病是较常见的一型。患者一岁以内会出现肌张力减退、眼球震颤及运动能力发育迟缓的症状。随着年龄增长，患者眼球震颤症状会停止但其他特征会恶化，包括痉挛、共济失调和舞蹈病样运动。先天型佩梅病病情相对严重。患者婴儿期发病，病症包括喂养困难、呼吸时有口哨声、进行性痉挛导致的关节挛缩、构音障碍、共济失调和癫痫。先天性佩梅病患者在运动能力和智力方面几乎没有发育。佩梅病患者需要一个多学科团队为其提供治疗，包括神经科、物理理疗、整形外科、肺内科及肠胃病相关医护人员。患者有严重的吞咽困难症状时需做胃造口手术。患者需使用抗癫痫药物治疗癫痫，用常规的治疗手段治疗痉挛包括物理疗法、锻炼、药物治疗（巴氯芬、替扎尼定、地西泮、肉毒杆菌毒素），有关节挛缩的患者还需做整形外科手术。佩梅病在美国男性人群的发病率为1/500000到1/200000之间，女性佩梅病患者很罕见。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>X连锁痉挛性截瘫2型（SPG2）是一种痉挛性截瘫，患者初发症状为痉挛步态和自主神经功能障碍。痉挛性截瘫2型可以以单纯型或复杂型出现。患有痉挛性截瘫2型的单纯型的人会出现下肢痉挛，通常没有任何额外的特征。患有痉挛性截瘫2型的复杂型的人具有下肢痉挛状态，并且还可能出现运动和平衡问题（共济失调）、眼睛不自主运动（眼球震颤）、轻度智力残疾、不自主的和有节奏的颤抖（震颤）、视神经变性（萎缩）。症状通常在1至5岁之间变得明显，受影响的人通常能够行走并且寿命正常。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>胎儿窘迫（参考来源：PMID20186781）<br>伴有步态障碍、面容畸形和行为异常的X连锁神经发育障碍(NEDGFAX)是典型特征是整体发育迟缓、肌张力低下、运动迟缓、智力发育受损以及言语和语言发育迟缓。患者还表现出面部畸形、胃肠道问题和眼部异常，极少数患者会出现癫痫。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is an inherited condition involving the brain and spinal cord (central nervous system) and one of a group of genetic disorders called leukodystrophies. Individuals with this condition have impaired intellectual functions and delayed motor skills. Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is divided into classic and connatal types, different in severity. Classic Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is the more common type. Within the first year of life, those affected with classic Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease typically experience hypotonia, nystagmus, and delayed development of motor skills. As the child gets older, nystagmus usually stops but other movement disorders develop, including spasticity, ataxia, and choreiform movements. The symptoms of connatal Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease can begin in infancy and include problems feeding, a whistling sound when breathing, progressive spasticity leading to contractures that restrict movement, dysarthria, ataxia, and seizures. A multidisciplinary team comprising specialists in neurology, physical medicine, orthopedics, pulmonary medicine, and gastroenterology should be assembled. Treatment may include gastrostomy for individuals with severe dysphagia; antiepileptic drugs (AEDs) for seizures; and routine management of spasticity including physical therapy, exercise, medications (baclofen, diazepam, tizanidine, botulinum toxin), orthotics, and surgery for joint contractures. The prevalence of Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease is estimated to be 1 in 200,000 to 500,000 males in the United States. This condition rarely affects females.(Source:OMIM)<br>Spastic paraplegia type 2 (SPG2) is an X-linked leukodystrophy characterized primarily by spastic gait and autonomic dysfunction.Spastic paraplegia type 2 can occur in either the pure or complex form. People with the complex form of spastic paraplegia type 2 have lower limb spasticity and can also experience problems with movement and balance (ataxia); involuntary movements of the eyes (nystagmus); mild intellectual disability; involuntary, rhythmic shaking (tremor); and degeneration (atrophy) of the optic nerves, which carry information from the eyes to the brain.  Symptoms usually become apparent between the ages of 1 and 5 years; those affected are typically able to walk and have a normal lifespan.(Source:OMIM)<br>Fetal distress(Source:PMID20186781)<br>X-linked neurodevelopmental disorder with gait disturbance, dysmorphic facies, and behavioral abnormalities (NEDGFAX) is an X-linked dominant disorder characterized by global developmental delay with hypotonia, motor delay, impaired intellectual development, and speech and language delay.             "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"CFHR3\", \"transcript\": \"NM_021023.5\", \"exon\": \"EX1\", \"effecttype\": \"duplication\", \"chr\": \"1\", \"start\": \"196735823\", \"stop\": \"196745114\", \"primer\": \"CFHR3;NM_021023.5;EX1 DUP;-;EX1;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"605336\", \"location\": \"1q31.3\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征1型易感性\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"{Hemolytic uremic syndrome, atypical, susceptibility to, 1}\", \"generalizationCn\": \"非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征1型是非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征的一种亚型。非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征是一种复杂遗传病，其特点为微血管病性溶血性贫血、血小板减少、肾衰竭，且通常没有小肠结肠炎和腹泻。与典型溶血性尿毒症综合征相比，非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征预后更差，表现为高死亡率和终末期肾病。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"An atypical form of hemolytic uremic syndrome. The vast majority of cases (90%) are sporadic, occur in children under 3 years of age, and are associated with epidemics of diarrhea caused by verotoxin-producing E. coli. The death rate is very low, about 30% of cases have renal sequelae, and there is usually no relapse of the disease. This form of HUS usually presents with a diarrhea prodrome (thus referred to as D+HUS) and has a good prognosis in most cases.             "generalizationCn": "非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征1型是非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征的一种亚型。非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征是一种复杂遗传病，其特点为微血管病性溶血性贫血、血小板减少、肾衰竭，且通常没有小肠结肠炎和腹泻。与典型溶血性尿毒症综合征相比，非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征预后更差，表现为高死亡率和终末期肾病。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>典型的溶血性尿毒症综合征的临床特征是急性肾功能衰竭、血小板减少和与畸形红细胞（burr细胞）相关的微血管病溶血性贫血。绝大多数病例（90%）是散发性的，发生在3岁以下儿童中，与产生维罗毒素的大肠杆菌引起的腹泻流行病有关，约30%的病例有肾脏后遗症，通常不会复发。这种形式的溶血性尿毒症综合征通常表现为腹泻前驱症状（因此称为D+溶血性尿毒综合征，D+HUS），并且在大多数情况下预后良好。相比之下，非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征患者没有小肠结肠炎和腹泻前驱症状（称为aHUS或D-HUS），预后较差，有复发倾向，经常发展为终末期肾衰竭。这些病例往往是家族性的，在常染色体隐性遗传和常染色体显性遗传中都有报道。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>老年性黄斑变性9型是老年性黄斑变性的一种亚型。老年性黄斑变性（ARMD）是黄斑区域的视网膜光感受器和下层视网膜色素上皮（RPE）细胞的进行性退化疾病。它是一种高发病率的疾病，也是西方世界失明的主要原因。脉络膜玻璃膜疣和其他沉积物会沉积在色素视网膜上皮细胞的Bruch膜上。临床和组织病理学调查表明，这些细胞外沉积物是早期ARMD的标志。随着ARMD的进展，RPE的逐渐萎缩可以导致视力丧失，或者发生脉络膜新生血管化导致湿性或渗出性ARMD，并伴中央视力丧失。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "An atypical form of hemolytic uremic syndrome. It is a complex genetic disease characterized by microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, renal failure and absence of episodes of enterocolitis and diarrhea. In contrast to typical hemolytic uremic syndrome, atypical forms have a poorer prognosis, with higher death rates and frequent progression to end-stage renal disease.(Source:OMIM)<br>Typical hemolytic uremic syndrome is characterized by acute renal failure, thrombocytopenia, and microangiopathic hemolytic anemia associated with distorted erythrocytes ('burr cells'). The vast majority of cases (90%) are sporadic, occur in children under 3 years of age, and are associated with epidemics of diarrhea caused by verotoxin-producing E. coli. The death rate is very low, about 30% of cases have renal sequelae, and there is usually no relapse of the disease. This form of HUS usually presents with a diarrhea prodrome (thus referred to as D+HUS) and has a good prognosis in most cases. In contrast, a subgroup of patients with HUS have an atypical presentation (aHUS or D-HUS) without a prodrome of enterocolitis and diarrhea and have a much poorer prognosis, with a tendency to relapse and frequent development of end-stage renal failure or death. These cases tend to be familial. Both autosomal recessive and autosomal dominant inheritance have been reported.(Source:OMIM)<br>Age-related macular degeneration (ARMD) is a progressive degeneration of photoreceptors and underlying retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) cells in the macula region of the retina. It is a highly prevalent disease and a major cause of blindness in the Western world. Drusen, pale excrescences of variable size, and other deposits accumulate below the RPE on the Bruch membrane; clinical and histopathologic investigations have shown that these extracellular deposits are the hallmark of early ARMD. As ARMD advances, areas of geographic atrophy of the RPE can cause visual loss, or choroidal neovascularization can occur to cause wet, or exudative, ARMD with accompanying central visual loss.(Source:OMIM)",

\"Hutchinson-Gilford早衰综合征（HGPS早衰）的特点是在童年时期表现为老化加速。尽管患者的症状和体征因发病的年龄而表现差异，但整体表现一致。HGPS患儿通常在出生时表现正常，第一年表现为严重的生长障碍、特殊面容伴有下颌后缩、鼻梁狭窄、尖形鼻尖。1岁至3岁这个阶段症状愈加明显，表现为部分脱发至完全脱发、皮下脂肪缺失、进行性关节挛缩、骨骼异常、甲营养不良、腹部和大腿上部肌肉异常紧张和皮肤外翻以及牙齿萌出延迟。后续的症状包括低频传导性听力损失、牙齿拥挤以及部分恒牙不萌出。一些患者还表现出畏光、过度流泪、暴露性角膜炎、雷诺现象。运动和智力发育正常。严重的并发症（如动脉粥样硬化、心肌梗死或中风）有致命风险，平均寿命大约是13岁（一般6-20岁）。血脂异常的治疗包括针对心血管的治疗、饮食调整和药物治疗（如他汀类）。发病率1:8000000-1:4000000。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome (HGPS, progeria) is characterized by clinical features that develop in childhood and resemble some features of accelerated aging. Although signs and symptoms vary in age of onset and severity, they are remarkably consistent overall. Children with HGPS usually appear normal at birth. Profound failure to thrive occurs during the first year. Characteristic facies, with receding mandible, narrow nasal bridge and pointed nasal tip develop. During the first to third year the following usually become apparent: partial alopecia progressing to total alopecia, loss of subcutaneous fat, progressive joint contractures, bone changes, nail dystrophy, and abnormal tightness and/or small soft outpouchings of the skin over the abdomen and upper thighs, and delayed primary tooth eruption. Later findings include low-frequency conductive hearing loss, dental crowding, and partial lack of secondary tooth eruption. Additional findings present in some but not all affected individuals include photophobia, excessive ocular tearing, exposure keratitis, and Raynaud phenomenon. Motor and mental development is normal. Death occurs as a result of complications of severe atherosclerosis, either cardiac disease (myocardial infarction) or cerebrovascular disease (stroke), generally between ages six and 20 years. "家族性部分脂肪营养障碍2型的主要特征为身体下部（如四肢、臀部、躯干）脂肪丧失。同时伴随面部及脸颊脂肪堆积、双下巴、颈部粗大、库欣综合征面容。脂肪也有可能堆积在腋下、后背、大阴唇或腹内区域。患者一般存在胰岛素抵抗，在20岁以后可发展为葡萄糖耐受不良、糖尿病、高甘油三酯血症、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平低。代谢并发症在青春期或成年期逐渐出现，包括胰岛素抵抗、糖尿病、肝脂肪变性、黑棘皮病、高血压和过早的动脉粥样硬化（冠心病风险增加）。一些患者可能表现出多囊卵巢综合征的特征，如多毛症、月经稀发、多囊卵巢和不孕症。所有患者通常易患早期心血管疾病。其他表现可能包括糖尿病并发症，复发性急性胰腺炎和肝脏脂肪性肝炎或肝硬化。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Slovenian型心-手综合征是一种具有临床和遗传异质性的疾病，特征为先天性心脏病和肢体畸形同时出现。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>扩张型心肌病1A型是扩张型心肌病的一种亚型。扩张型心肌病是一种以心室扩大及心脏收缩功能障碍为特点的疾病，该疾病导致心脏充血困难和心律不齐。患者有猝死风险。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Charcot-Marie-Tooth病2B1型是一种轴突型CMT，CMT是一种周围神经系统疾病，表现为始于腓骨肌后发展到手臂远端肌肉的进行性肌无力和肌萎缩。CMT2组的神经病变的特征是轴突变性的迹象，但没有明显的髓磷脂改变，神经传导速度正常或略有降低，以及进行性远端肌肉无力和萎缩。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良2型是Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良的一种亚型。Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良（EDMD）是一种退行性肌病，主要特点为不累及神经系统的肌无力和肌肉萎缩、早发性肘部（还包括跟腱、脊柱）挛缩、心肌疾病伴心脏传导缺陷。几乎所有患者都存在心脏缺陷。治疗手段包括进行缓解挛缩和脊柱侧凸处理的手术，在心脏衰竭后期做心脏移植手术等。发病率为1:100,000。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良3型是Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良的一种亚型。Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良（EDMD）是一种退行性肌病，主要特点为不累及神经系统的肌无力和肌肉萎缩、早发性肘部（还包括跟腱、脊柱）挛缩、心肌疾病伴心脏传导缺陷。几乎所有患者都存在心脏缺陷。治疗手段包括进行缓解挛缩和脊柱侧凸处理的手术，在心脏衰竭后期做心脏移植手术等。发病率为1:100,000。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Hutchinson-Gilford早衰综合征（HGPS早衰）的特点是在童年时期表现为老化加速。尽管患者的症状和体征因发病的年龄而表现差异，但整体表现一致。HGPS患儿通常在出生时表现正常，第一年表现为严重的生长障碍、特殊面容伴有下颌后缩、鼻梁狭窄、尖形鼻尖。1岁至3岁这个阶段症状愈加明显，表现为部分脱发至完全脱发、皮下脂肪缺失、进行性关节挛缩、骨骼异常、甲营养不良、腹部和大腿上部肌肉异常紧张和皮肤外翻以及牙齿萌出延迟。后续的症状包括低频传导性听力损失、牙齿拥挤以及部分恒牙不萌出。一些患者还表现出畏光、过度流泪、暴露性角膜炎、雷诺现象。运动和智力发育正常。严重的并发症（如动脉粥样硬化、心肌梗死或中风）有致命风险，平均寿命大约是13岁（一般6-20岁）。血脂异常的治疗包括针对心血管的治疗、饮食调整和药物治疗（如他汀类）。发病率1:8000000-1:4000000。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>扩张型心肌病伴高促性腺激素性性腺功能减退症是以生殖器异常、高促性腺激素性性腺功能减退症和扩张型心肌病为特征的一种疾病。该疾病的患者会出现其他多样临床特征，包括智力障碍、骨骼异常、硬皮病、头发灰白稀疏和骨质疏松。扩张型心肌病以心室扩张和心肌收缩功能损伤为特点，导致充血性心力衰竭和心律不齐。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>LAMA相关性先天性肌营养不良是先天性肌肉萎缩症的一种亚型。先天性肌肉萎缩症患者在出生时或者出生后的最初几个月发病，表现为肌张力低下、肌无力，常伴有关节挛缩。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>致死性限制性皮肤病的主要临床症状为胎儿宫内发育迟缓、皮肤糜烂、浅表血管突出、表皮角化过度、面部畸形（小口，小鼻子和小颌畸形）、睫毛和眉毛稀疏（或无）、颅骨矿化缺陷、锁骨发育不良、肺发育不良、多关节挛缩。患者出生后一般在一个星期内死亡。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>下颌骨肢端发育异常伴A型脂营养不良(MADA) 临床特征为生长迟缓、颅面异常伴下颌发育不全、骨骼异常伴远端指骨和锁骨进行性骨溶解以及皮肤色素改变。脂肪营养不良的特征是肢端脂肪组织明显减少，而颈部和躯干脂肪组织正常或增加。一些患者还可能表现出早衰特征。胰岛素抵抗和糖尿病可能会导致代谢并发症。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>限制性皮肤病是一种罕见的遗传性皮肤病，主要特征为宫内发育迟缓、皮肤紧绷和僵硬伴糜烂、明显的浅表血管和表皮角化过度、面部畸形（小嘴、小鼻子和小颌）、睫毛和眉毛稀疏/缺失、颅骨矿化缺陷、颅骨发育不良、锁骨发育不良、肺发育不全、多发性关节挛缩和早期新生儿致命。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>胎动减少（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "A disorder characterized by the loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the lower parts of the body (limbs, buttocks, trunk). \"Hutchinson-Gilford早衰综合征（HGPS早衰）的特点是在童年时期表现为老化加速。尽管患者的症状和体征因发病的年龄而表现差异，但整体表现一致。HGPS患儿通常在出生时表现正常，第一年表现为严重的生长障碍、特殊面容伴有下颌后缩、鼻梁狭窄、尖形鼻尖。1岁至3岁这个阶段症状愈加明显，表现为部分脱发至完全脱发、皮下脂肪缺失、进行性关节挛缩、骨骼异常、甲营养不良、腹部和大腿上部肌肉异常紧张和皮肤外翻以及牙齿萌出延迟。后续的症状包括低频传导性听力损失、牙齿拥挤以及部分恒牙不萌出。一些患者还表现出畏光、过度流泪、暴露性角膜炎、雷诺现象。运动和智力发育正常。严重的并发症（如动脉粥样硬化、心肌梗死或中风）有致命风险，平均寿命大约是13岁（一般6-20岁）。血脂异常的治疗包括针对心血管的治疗、饮食调整和药物治疗（如他汀类）。发病率1:8000000-1:4000000。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome (HGPS, progeria) is characterized by clinical features that develop in childhood and resemble some features of accelerated aging. Although signs and symptoms vary in age of onset and severity, they are remarkably consistent overall. Children with HGPS usually appear normal at birth. Profound failure to thrive occurs during the first year. Characteristic facies, with receding mandible, narrow nasal bridge and pointed nasal tip develop. During the first to third year the following usually become apparent: partial alopecia progressing to total alopecia, loss of subcutaneous fat, progressive joint contractures, bone changes, nail dystrophy, and abnormal tightness and/or small soft outpouchings of the skin over the abdomen and upper thighs, and delayed primary tooth eruption. Later findings include low-frequency conductive hearing loss, dental crowding, and partial lack of secondary tooth eruption. Additional findings present in some but not all affected individuals include photophobia, excessive ocular tearing, exposure keratitis, and Raynaud phenomenon. Motor and mental development is normal. Death occurs as a result of complications of severe atherosclerosis, either cardiac disease (myocardial infarction) or cerebrovascular disease (stroke), generally between ages six and 20 years. "家族性部分脂肪营养障碍2型的主要特征为身体下部（如四肢、臀部、躯干）脂肪丧失。同时伴随面部及脸颊脂肪堆积、双下巴、颈部粗大、库欣综合征面容。脂肪也有可能堆积在腋下、后背、大阴唇或腹内区域。患者一般存在胰岛素抵抗，在20岁以后可发展为葡萄糖耐受不良、糖尿病、高甘油三酯血症、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平低。代谢并发症在青春期或成年期逐渐出现，包括胰岛素抵抗、糖尿病、肝脂肪变性、黑棘皮病、高血压和过早的动脉粥样硬化（冠心病风险增加）。一些患者可能表现出多囊卵巢综合征的特征，如多毛症、月经稀发、多囊卵巢和不孕症。所有患者通常易患早期心血管疾病。其他表现可能包括糖尿病并发症，复发性急性胰腺炎和肝脏脂肪性肝炎或肝硬化。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Slovenian型心-手综合征是一种具有临床和遗传异质性的疾病，特征为先天性心脏病和肢体畸形同时出现。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>扩张型心肌病1A型是扩张型心肌病的一种亚型。扩张型心肌病是一种以心室扩大及心脏收缩功能障碍为特点的疾病，该疾病导致心脏充血困难和心律不齐。患者有猝死风险。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Charcot-Marie-Tooth病2B1型是一种轴突型CMT，CMT是一种周围神经系统疾病，表现为始于腓骨肌后发展到手臂远端肌肉的进行性肌无力和肌萎缩。CMT2组的神经病变的特征是轴突变性的迹象，但没有明显的髓磷脂改变，神经传导速度正常或略有降低，以及进行性远端肌肉无力和萎缩。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良2型是Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良的一种亚型。Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良（EDMD）是一种退行性肌病，主要特点为不累及神经系统的肌无力和肌肉萎缩、早发性肘部（还包括跟腱、脊柱）挛缩、心肌疾病伴心脏传导缺陷。几乎所有患者都存在心脏缺陷。治疗手段包括进行缓解挛缩和脊柱侧凸处理的手术，在心脏衰竭后期做心脏移植手术等。发病率为1:100,000。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良3型是Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良的一种亚型。Emery-Dreifuss肌营养不良（EDMD）是一种退行性肌病，主要特点为不累及神经系统的肌无力和肌肉萎缩、早发性肘部（还包括跟腱、脊柱）挛缩、心肌疾病伴心脏传导缺陷。几乎所有患者都存在心脏缺陷。治疗手段包括进行缓解挛缩和脊柱侧凸处理的手术，在心脏衰竭后期做心脏移植手术等。发病率为1:100,000。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Hutchinson-Gilford早衰综合征（HGPS早衰）的特点是在童年时期表现为老化加速。尽管患者的症状和体征因发病的年龄而表现差异，但整体表现一致。HGPS患儿通常在出生时表现正常，第一年表现为严重的生长障碍、特殊面容伴有下颌后缩、鼻梁狭窄、尖形鼻尖。1岁至3岁这个阶段症状愈加明显，表现为部分脱发至完全脱发、皮下脂肪缺失、进行性关节挛缩、骨骼异常、甲营养不良、腹部和大腿上部肌肉异常紧张和皮肤外翻以及牙齿萌出延迟。后续的症状包括低频传导性听力损失、牙齿拥挤以及部分恒牙不萌出。一些患者还表现出畏光、过度流泪、暴露性角膜炎、雷诺现象。运动和智力发育正常。严重的并发症（如动脉粥样硬化、心肌梗死或中风）有致命风险，平均寿命大约是13岁（一般6-20岁）。血脂异常的治疗包括针对心血管的治疗、饮食调整和药物治疗（如他汀类）。发病率1:8000000-1:4000000。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>扩张型心肌病伴高促性腺激素性性腺功能减退症是以生殖器异常、高促性腺激素性性腺功能减退症和扩张型心肌病为特征的一种疾病。该疾病的患者会出现其他多样临床特征，包括智力障碍、骨骼异常、硬皮病、头发灰白稀疏和骨质疏松。扩张型心肌病以心室扩张和心肌收缩功能损伤为特点，导致充血性心力衰竭和心律不齐。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>LAMA相关性先天性肌营养不良是先天性肌肉萎缩症的一种亚型。先天性肌肉萎缩症患者在出生时或者出生后的最初几个月发病，表现为肌张力低下、肌无力，常伴有关节挛缩。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>致死性限制性皮肤病的主要临床症状为胎儿宫内发育迟缓、皮肤糜烂、浅表血管突出、表皮角化过度、面部畸形（小口，小鼻子和小颌畸形）、睫毛和眉毛稀疏（或无）、颅骨矿化缺陷、锁骨发育不良、肺发育不良、多关节挛缩。患者出生后一般在一个星期内死亡。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>下颌骨肢端发育异常伴A型脂营养不良(MADA) 临床特征为生长迟缓、颅面异常伴下颌发育不全、骨骼异常伴远端指骨和锁骨进行性骨溶解以及皮肤色素改变。脂肪营养不良的特征是肢端脂肪组织明显减少，而颈部和躯干脂肪组织正常或增加。一些患者还可能表现出早衰特征。胰岛素抵抗和糖尿病可能会导致代谢并发症。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>限制性皮肤病是一种罕见的遗传性皮肤病，主要特征为宫内发育迟缓、皮肤紧绷和僵硬伴糜烂、明显的浅表血管和表皮角化过度、面部畸形（小嘴、小鼻子和小颌）、睫毛和眉毛稀疏/缺失、颅骨矿化缺陷、颅骨发育不良、锁骨发育不良、肺发育不全、多发性关节挛缩和早期新生儿致命。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>胎动减少（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "A disorder characterized by the loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the lower parts of the body (limbs, buttocks, trunk).             "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"CFHR1\", \"transcript\": \"NM_002113.2\", \"exon\": \"EX1-EX6E\", \"effecttype\": \"deletion\", \"chr\": \"1\", \"start\": \"196744018\", \"stop\": \"196801129\", \"primer\": \"CFHR1;NM_002113.2;EX1-EX6E DEL;-;EX1-EX6E;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"134371\", \"location\": \"1q31.3\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征易感性\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"{Hemolytic uremic syndrome, atypical, susceptibility to}\", \"generalizationCn\": \"典型的溶血性尿毒症综合征的临床特征是急性肾功能衰竭、血小板减少和与畸形红细胞（burr细胞）相关的微血管病溶血性贫血。绝大多数病例（90%）是散发性的，发生在3岁以下儿童中，与产生维罗毒素的大肠杆菌引起的腹泻流行病有关，约30%的病例有肾脏后遗症，通常不会复发。这种形式的溶血性尿毒症综合征通常表现为腹泻前驱症状（因此称为D+溶血性尿毒综合征，D+HUS），并且在大多数情况下预后良好。相比之下，非典型溶血性尿毒症综合征患者没有小肠结肠炎和腹泻前驱症状（称为aHUS或D-HUS），预后较差，有复发倾向，经常发展为终末期肾衰竭。这些病例往往是家族性的，在常染色体隐性遗传和常染色体显性遗传中都有报道。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Typical hemolytic uremic syndrome is characterized by acute renal failure, thrombocytopenia, and microangiopathic hemolytic anemia associated with distorted erythrocytes ('burr cells'). The vast majority of cases (90%) are sporadic, occur in children under 3 years of age, and are associated with epidemics of diarrhea caused by verotoxin-producing E. coli. The death rate is very low, about 30% of cases have renal sequelae, and there is usually no relapse of the disease. This form of HUS usually presents with a diarrhea prodrome (thus referred to as D+HUS) and has a good prognosis in most cases.             "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"SCN1A\", \"transcript\": \"NM_001165963.1\", \"exon\": \"EX17-EX20\", \"effecttype\": \"deletion\", \"chr\": \"2\", \"start\": \"166866230\", \"stop\": \"166872237\", \"primer\": \"SCN1A;NM_001165963.1;EX17-EX20 DEL;-;EX17-EX20;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"182389\", \"location\": \"2q24.3\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"家族性偏瘫型偏头痛3型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Familial Hemiplegic Migraine 3\", \"generalizationCn\": \"家族性偏瘫型偏头痛3型是偏头痛的一种亚型。偏头痛是一种以反复发作性、搏动样头痛为主要表现的慢性病。头痛多为偏侧，一般持续4-72小时，可伴有恶心、呕吐，以及对光、声刺激或气味敏感。偏头疼的发病受遗传因素和外界环境的共同影响，2/3的患者具有家族史。家族性偏瘫型偏头痛（FHM）是一种常染色体显性的典型偏头痛亚型，具有可持续数小时，数天或数周偏侧身体疼痛的特点，主要伴随症状为半身无力、共济失调、昏迷及瘫痪等。有些患者中伴有进行性小脑共济失调。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Migraine is a primary headache disorder characterized by recurrent headaches that are moderate to severe. It can be accompanied by other symptoms, such as ataxia, coma and paralysis.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"609634\", \"omimGeneId\": \"182389\", \"systemSort\": \"神经肌肉系统疾病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AD\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由神经元电压门控钠通道基因 (SCN1A, 182389.0012) 亚基 A 突变引起;全身性癫痫发作等位基因疾病（GEFS+，604233）;遗传异质性，见FHM1 141500;失明发作与FHM发作无关;发作频率和持续时间不同;前 2 个十年发病（范围 6 至 15 岁）;癫痫发作（在婴儿期的一部分患者中）;偏瘫;有先兆的偏头痛;偏头痛;发作间期视网膜和瞳孔反射正常;失明发作期间瞳孔反射消失;持续3至10秒的短暂失明（由光线、突然站立或直接按压眼睑引起）;诱发性每日重复失明（ERDB）;畏光;常染色体显性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"20岁前发病（6-15岁)\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"早发幼儿癫痫性脑病6型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Early Infantile Epileptic Encephalopathy 6\", \"generalizationCn\": \"早发幼儿癫痫性脑病6型又称Dravet综合征或婴儿严重肌阵挛性癫痫（SMEI），患者1岁以内起病（通常在6个月左右，一些再在3个月前），癫痫一般不会缓解，早期的癫痫经常是长时发热性癫痫，癫痫可由中度发热引发。各种癫痫均有可能，其中以全身强直性痉挛发作、肌阵挛性和半惊厥状态的发作最为常见。肌阵挛性癫痫一般发生在后期，常与认知功能障碍、共济失调和精神运动倒退伴发。起病初期脑电图正常，但随着时间的推移出现癫痫样的活动，表现为广泛的、局灶或多灶性棘慢波及多棘慢波。Dravet综合征的发病率为1:40,000。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"This phenotype is defined as seizures with onset during the first year of life (usually around age six months; in some cases before age three months) that do not remit, and usually evolve to include myoclonic seizures.Early seizures are often prolonged febrile seizures. Seizures can sometimes be provoked by modest hyperthermia (e.g., a hot bath, physical exertion)Any seizure type is possible; generalized tonic-clonic, myoclonic, and hemiconvulsive seizures are most common.Myoclonic seizures tend to appear later in the course, often coinciding with the appearance of cognitive dysfunction, ataxia, and psychomotor regression.Status epilepticus is common, and pharmacologic management is difficult.The initial EEGs are often normal, but over time epileptiform activity appears. Patterns can include generalized spike and wave discharges, multiple spike and wave (also referred to as polyspike and wave) discharges, and multifocal spikes.From an analysis of data on children with seizures from a national database, Hurst (1990) determined that the incidence of SMEI is 1 in 40,000.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"607208\", \"omimGeneId\": \"182389\", \"systemSort\": \"神经肌肉系统疾病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AD\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由钠电压门控通道 α 亚基 1 基因 (SCN1A, 182389.0007) 突变引起;新发突变（在大多数情况下）;癫痫发作对药物治疗无效;可能由发烧或热水浴引起;精神运动延迟在癫痫发作时可能很明显;精神运动迟缓通常在 2 岁左右变得明显;脑电图起初可能正常;出生后第一年发病;表型变异;脑萎缩（严重时）;迁移性局灶性或多灶性癫痫发作（严重病例）;在 EEG 上看到的广义尖峰或多尖峰波和局灶尖峰;癫痫持续状态;共济失调;认知功能恶化;发育退化（在某些患者中）;智力发育受损，严重程度不一;精神运动发育迟缓;多种癫痫发作类型;肌阵挛发作;复杂部分性发作;失神发作;单侧阵挛发作;全身性阵挛或强直-阵挛发作;皮质视觉障碍（严重的情况下）;获得性小头畸形（在严重的情况下）;常染色体显性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"周岁前发病\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"家族性热性惊厥3A型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Febrile seizures, familial, 3A\", \"generalizationCn\": \"家族性热性惊厥3A型与全身性癫痫伴热性惊厥2型相关。全身性癫痫伴热性惊厥2型 (GEFSP2) 是一种神经系统疾病，其特征是在出生后最初几个月或几年内出现与发烧相关的癫痫发作。受影响的个体在以后的生活中继续出现各种类型的热性和非热性惊厥，包括全身强直阵挛性惊厥（GTCS）。有些患者可能会在最初或第二个十年内癫痫发作消失；极少数患者可能有轻度智力发育障碍。相比之下，孤立性热性惊厥 (FEB3A) 患者在 6 个月至 4 岁时发病，到 6 岁时出现自发缓解，并且认知能力正常。因此，SCN1A 基因突变会导致一系列癫痫疾病，从早发的孤立性热性惊厥到伴有热性惊厥的全身性癫痫加 2 型（代表更严重的表型）。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 2 (GEFSP2) is an autosomal dominant neurologic disorder characterized by the onset of seizures associated with fever in the first months or years of life. Affected individuals continue to have various types of febrile and afebrile seizures later in life, including generalized tonic-clonic seizures (GTCS). Some patients may have offset of seizures in the first or second decades; rare patients may have mildly impaired intellectual development. In contrast, patients with isolated febrile seizures (FEB3A) have onset between ages 6 months and 4 years, show spontaneous remission by age 6 years, and have normal cognition. Mutations in the SCN1A gene thus cause a spectrum of seizure disorders, ranging from early-onset isolated febrile seizures to generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 2, which represents a more severe phenotype.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"604403\", \"omimGeneId\": \"182389\", \"systemSort\": \"神经肌肉系统疾病\", \"heredityModel\": \"AD\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"由电压门控钠通道 I 型 α 多肽基因 (SCN1A, 182389.0001) 突变引起;2% 到 7% 的儿童在以后的生活中会出现无热惊厥;33% 的患者癫痫复发;一些患者有更严重的表型，儿童期后有高热和无热惊厥 (GEFS+);可变严重性;单纯性热性惊厥通常在 6 岁时缓解;热性惊厥发作通常在 6 个月至 6 岁之间;患者精神运动发育正常;部分性癫痫发作;偏侧阵挛性发作;肌阵挛发作;失神发作;全身强直阵挛性发作;发热性惊厥;与发热相关的全身性癫痫发作;常染色体显性遗传\", \"ageOnset\": \"6个月-6岁热性惊厥发作\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"全身性癫痫伴高热惊厥2型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Epilepsy, generalized, with febrile seizures plus, type 2\", \"generalizationCn\": \"全身性癫痫伴高热惊厥2型是全身性癫痫伴高热惊厥的一种亚型。全身性癫痫伴高热惊厥临床症状是患者出现高热惊厥（症状有时持续到6岁以后）和（或）多种无热惊厥。该疾病同时表现出高热惊厥、由发热引发的全身性癫痫（6岁及以上）或不同程度的部分性癫痫。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"A rare autosomal dominant, familial condition with incomplete penetrance and large intrafamilial variability.             "generalizationCn": "家族性偏瘫型偏头痛3型是偏头痛的一种亚型。偏头痛是一种以反复发作性、搏动样头痛为主要表现的慢性病。头痛多为偏侧，一般持续4-72小时，可伴有恶心、呕吐，以及对光、声刺激或气味敏感。偏头疼的发病受遗传因素和外界环境的共同影响，2/3的患者具有家族史。家族性偏瘫型偏头痛（FHM）是一种常染色体显性的典型偏头痛亚型，具有可持续数小时，数天或数周偏侧身体疼痛的特点，主要伴随症状为半身无力、共济失调、昏迷及瘫痪等。有些患者中伴有进行性小脑共济失调。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>早发幼儿癫痫性脑病6型又称Dravet综合征或婴儿严重肌阵挛性癫痫（SMEI），患者1岁以内起病（通常在6个月左右，一些再在3个月前），癫痫一般不会缓解，早期的癫痫经常是长时发热性癫痫，癫痫可由中度发热引发。各种癫痫均有可能，其中以全身强直性痉挛发作、肌阵挛性和半惊厥状态的发作最为常见。肌阵挛性癫痫一般发生在后期，常与认知功能障碍、共济失调和精神运动倒退伴发。起病初期脑电图正常，但随着时间的推移出现癫痫样的活动，表现为广泛的、局灶或多灶性棘慢波及多棘慢波。Dravet综合征的发病率为1:40,000。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>家族性热性惊厥3A型与全身性癫痫伴热性惊厥2型相关。全身性癫痫伴热性惊厥2型 (GEFSP2) 是一种神经系统疾病，其特征是在出生后最初几个月或几年内出现与发烧相关的癫痫发作。受影响的个体在以后的生活中继续出现各种类型的热性和非热性惊厥，包括全身强直阵挛性惊厥（GTCS）。有些患者可能会在最初或第二个十年内癫痫发作消失；极少数患者可能有轻度智力发育障碍。相比之下，孤立性热性惊厥 (FEB3A) 患者在 6 个月至 4 岁时发病，到 6 岁时出现自发缓解，并且认知能力正常。因此，SCN1A 基因突变会导致一系列癫痫疾病，从早发的孤立性热性惊厥到伴有热性惊厥的全身性癫痫加 2 型（代表更严重的表型）。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>全身性癫痫伴高热惊厥2型是全身性癫痫伴高热惊厥的一种亚型。全身性癫痫伴高热惊厥临床症状是患者出现高热惊厥（症状有时持续到6岁以后）和（或）多种无热惊厥。该疾病同时表现出高热惊厥、由发热引发的全身性癫痫（6岁及以上）或不同程度的部分性癫痫。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>发育性和癫痫性脑病-6B型（DEE6B）是一种严重的神经发育障碍，其特征是婴儿早期癫痫发作、智力发育严重受损和多动性运动障碍。脑成像通常显示进行性萎缩和其他异常。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "Migraine is a primary headache disorder characterized by recurrent headaches that are moderate to severe. Typically, the headaches affects one half of the head, are pulsating in nature, and lasts from two to 72 hours.Associated symptoms may include nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light, sound, or smell.The pain is generally made worse by physical activity.Migraines are believed to be due to a mixture of environmental and genetic factors. About two-thirds of cases run in families. Familial hemiplegic migraine (FHM) is an autosomal dominant classical migraine subtype that typically includes weakness of half the body which can last for hours, days or weeks. It can be accompanied by other symptoms, such as ataxia, coma and paralysis.(Source:OMIM)<br>This phenotype is defined as seizures with onset during the first year of life (usually around age six months; in some cases before age three months) that do not remit, and usually evolve to include myoclonic seizures.Early seizures are often prolonged febrile seizures. Seizures can sometimes be provoked by modest hyperthermia (e.g., a hot bath, physical exertion)Any seizure type is possible; generalized tonic-clonic, myoclonic, and hemiconvulsive seizures are most common.Myoclonic seizures tend to appear later in the course, often coinciding with the appearance of cognitive dysfunction, ataxia, and psychomotor regression.Status epilepticus is common, and pharmacologic management is difficult.The initial EEGs are often normal, but over time epileptiform activity appears. Patterns can include generalized spike and wave discharges, multiple spike and wave (also referred to as polyspike and wave) discharges, and multifocal spikes.From an analysis of data on children with seizures from a national database, Hurst (1990) determined that the incidence of SMEI is 1 in 40,000.(Source:OMIM)<br>Generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 2 (GEFSP2) is an autosomal dominant neurologic disorder characterized by the onset of seizures associated with fever in the first months or years of life. Affected individuals continue to have various types of febrile and afebrile seizures later in life, including generalized tonic-clonic seizures (GTCS). Some patients may have offset of seizures in the first or second decades; rare patients may have mildly impaired intellectual development. In contrast, patients with isolated febrile seizures (FEB3A) have onset between ages 6 months and 4 years, show spontaneous remission by age 6 years, and have normal cognition. Mutations in the SCN1A gene thus cause a spectrum of seizure disorders, ranging from early-onset isolated febrile seizures to generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 2, which represents a more severe phenotype.(Source:OMIM)<br>A rare autosomal dominant, familial condition with incomplete penetrance and large intrafamilial variability. Patients display febrile seizures persisting sometimes beyond the age of 6 years and/or a variety of afebrile seizure types. This disease combines febrile seizures, generalized seizures often precipitated by fever at age 6 years or more, and partial seizures, with a variable degree of severity.(Source:OMIM)<br>Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy-6B (DEE6B) is a severe neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by early-infantile seizure onset, profoundly impaired intellectual development, and a hyperkinetic movement disorder. Brain imaging usually shows progressive atrophy and other abnormalities.(Source:OMIM)",

            "generalizationCn": "遗传性肌病伴早发性呼吸衰竭是一种慢性渐进性肌病，通常在生命的第三到第五个十年发病，主要临床症状包括与小腿远端无力相关的步态障碍、或由于呼吸系统肌肉无力导致的夜间呼吸系统障碍。最终肌无力症状会逐渐影响近端和远端的肌肉，大部分患者在发病的前几年需要行走器辅助，进而发展为需要依赖轮椅及夜间无创通气系统。遗传性肌病伴早发性呼吸衰竭具有临床异质性，同一个家系的个体会呈现不同的临床症状，有些患者到70多岁还可以自己走路，而有些患者40岁时需要呼吸机支持。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>胫骨肌营养不良是一种常染色体显性遗传晚发型远端肌病。临床表征为肌无力和肌萎缩，通常局限于小腿，特别是胫骨前肌。发病年龄通常在35-45岁，甚至更晚。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>肢带型肌营养不良2J型（LGMD2J）是一种严重早发性肌营养不良症，临床特征为所有近端肌肉无力。第一个报道的患者在十岁时出现无力，在接下来的20年内丧失独立行走能力。患者在三四十岁时有时伴有其他不太严重的临床特征，如下肢远端肌无力。疾病进行性缓慢发展，没有更严重的残疾。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>家族性肥厚型心肌病9型是家族性肥厚型心肌病的一种亚型。家族性肥厚型心肌病是一种以心室不对称肥厚并常累及室间隔的一类家族式遗传性心脏疾病。患者很容易因为运动而引发多种症状，包括呼吸困难、晕厥、摔倒、心悸及胸痛等。本病在家族间和家族内部成员之间可表现出从良性到恶性的差异，具有很高的心衰和心源性猝死的风险。不同个体间表型差异较大。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>扩张型心肌病1G型是扩张型心肌病的一种亚型。扩张型心肌病是一种以心室扩大及心脏收缩功能障碍为特点的疾病，该疾病导致心脏充血困难和心律不齐。患者有猝死风险。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>先天性肌病5型伴心肌病（CMYP5）特征是婴儿期肌肉无力，表现为新生儿肌张力低下，运动发育延迟，常伴有肢体远端挛缩。患者可能有先天性心脏缺陷，多数在儿童期或青春期发展为严重的心肌病。骨骼肌活检显示多微小核肌病，细胞核位于中心和1型肌纤维较多。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>胎儿臀位；死胎；胎动不佳；胎儿水肿；羊水过多；多发性关节痉挛；新生儿呼吸窘迫；小于胎龄；缺乏自发运动；小颌畸形；腭裂；纤细骨骼；细肋骨；长骨骨折；肌病脸；胸部狭窄；阴囊发育不全；马蹄内翻足；轻度弯曲指；球状指尖；左股骨骨折；双侧髋关节发育不良；上肢和下肢运动不良；严重肌张力减退；肢体挛缩；深部腱反射消失；高腭弓；全身无力；双侧肱骨和左股骨的螺旋形骨折（参考来源：PMID29575618;PMID33082562;PMID28040389）",
            "generalizationEn": "Hereditary myopathy with early respiratory failure (HMERF) is a slowly progressive myopathy that typically begins in the third to fifth decades of life. The usual presenting findings are gait disturbance relating to distal leg weakness or nocturnal respiratory symptoms due to respiratory muscle weakness. Weakness eventually generalizes and affects both proximal and distal muscles. Most affected individuals require walking aids within a few years of onset; some progress to wheelchair dependence and require nocturnal noninvasive ventilatory support. The disease course varies even among individuals within the same family: some remain ambulant until their 70s whereas others may require ventilator support in their 40s.(Source:OMIM)<br>Autosomal dominant, late-onset distal myopathy. Muscle weakness and atrophy are usually confined to the anterior compartment of the lower leg, in particular the tibialis anterior muscle. Clinical symptoms usually occur at age 35-45 years or much later.(Source:OMIM)<br>LGMD2J is a severe, early onset disorder characterized by weakness of all proximal muscles. In the first reported cases weakness appeared in the first decade of life and progressed over the next 20 years to wheelchair confinement. Patients with the other, less severe, clinical presentation showed onset of distal muscle weakness in lower limbs in the third or fourth decade of life. Progression was very slow without greater disability throughout their lifetime.(Source:OMIM)<br>A hereditary heart disorder characterized by ventricular hypertrophy, which is usually asymmetric and often involves the interventricular septum. The symptoms include dyspnea, syncope, collapse, palpitations, and chest pain. They can be readily provoked by exercise. The disorder has inter- and intrafamilial variability ranging from benign to malignant forms with high risk of cardiac failure and sudden cardiac death.(Source:OMIM)<br>A disorder characterized by ventricular dilation and impaired systolic function, resulting in congestive heart failure and arrhythmia. Patients are at risk of premature death.(Source:OMIM)<br>Congenital myopathy-5 with cardiomyopathy (CMYP5) is an autosomal recessive disorder characterized by the onset of muscle weakness in infancy manifest as neonatal hypotonia, delayed motor development, and often distal contractures. Affected individuals may have congenital heart defects and most develop severe cardiomyopathy in childhood or adolescence .             "generalizationCn": "常染色体显性耳聋78型的特征是先天性发作并严重影响所有频率的双侧感觉神经性听力丧失。部分患者可能会因前庭功能障碍而在生命早期出现轻度的运动延迟，但随着年龄的增长其运动能力逐步恢复。受影响个体没有其他全身或神经系统表型。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Kilquist综合征（KILQS）是一种常染色体隐性遗传的多系统疾病，其特征是神经系统、胃肠道和分泌功能障碍。患病的婴儿出生时表现肌张力低下、进食困难、轻度畸形和感音神经性听力减退。表现为整体生长不良并伴有胃肠道异常，如胃食管反流或中肠旋转不良、严重的整体发育迟缓、不能坐或说话。泪液、汗液和唾液的产生也会受到损害，导致口干和支气管粘液反复堵塞。部分临床特征使人联想到囊性纤维化。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Delpire-McNeill综合征(DELMNES)是一种表现高度多变的神经发育障碍。婴儿期患者出现整体发育迟缓，包括运动、语言和智力发育受损。最严重的患者有肌张力减退、无法支撑头部或行走、双侧感音神经性耳聋和语言障碍，而其他患者有行走迟缓和轻度至中度智力残疾，通常有言语迟缓和自闭症特征。更多的可变特征可能包括痉挛或其他器官系统的轻微累及，如髋关节脱位或室间隔缺损。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "Autosomal dominant deafness-78 (DFNA78) is characterized by congenital onset of profound bilateral sensorineural hearing loss affecting all frequencies. Affected individuals do not have systemic or other neurologic manifestations.(Source:OMIM)<br>Kilquist syndrome (KILQS) is an autosomal recessive multisystem disorder characterized by neurologic, gastrointestinal, and secretory dysfunction. Affected individuals present at birth with hypotonia, feeding difficulties, mild dysmorphic features, and sensorineural hearing loss. They show poor overall growth associated with gastrointestinal anomalies such as gastroesophageal reflux or midgut malrotation, as well as profound global developmental delay with inability to sit or speak. Tear, sweat, and saliva production is also impaired, causing dry mouth and recurrent bronchial mucus plugging. Some of the clinical features are reminiscent of cystic fibrosis.(Source:OMIM)<br>Delpire-McNeill syndrome (DELMNES) is a neurodevelopmental disorder with highly variable manifestations. The most severely affected patients have hypotonia, inability to hold their head or walk, bilateral sensorineural deafness, and absent language, whereas others have delayed walking and mild to moderate intellectual disability, often with speech delay and autistic features. More variable features may include spasticity or minor involvement of other organ systems, such as hip dislocation or ventricular septal defect.(Source:OMIM)",

            "gene": "-",
            "generalizationCn": "补体C4A缺乏症是一种罕见的补体经典途径缺陷而导致的免疫性疾病，表现为自身免疫性疾病、系统性红斑狼疮伴（或不伴）肾小球肾炎。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Chido和Rodgers血型系统是C4蛋白抗原表位，这些抗原表位和多态性在病人输血中可能导致Ch或Rg抗原抗体的形成。抗Ch和抗Rg的识别依赖于抗体与Ch-positive 或 Rg-positive个体的中和反应以及与合适的Ch-negative或Rg-negative红细胞缺乏反应性。C4蛋白以两种形式存在:C4A和C4B，是由密切相连的两个基因编码的。C4A和C4B的单链前体均为1744个几乎完全相同的氨基酸，只是在1101-1106位有区别。C4A和C4B通常是通过表达ch抗原或者是Rg抗原来进行区分识别，该抗原是在1188到1191残基位置，Ch1抗原决定表位有ADLR以及Rg1抗原决定表位有VDLL。虽然在某些单倍体型中这种关系可能会被交换，但是C4A蛋白通常携带Rg抗原，C4B抗原通常携带Ch抗原。Ch/Rg系统已经识别了9个抗原：6个高频Ch，2个高频Rg，一个低频WH。已经确立Ch/Rg系统8种表型，有88.2%的个体有Ch(1,2,3)血型抗体表型以及95%的个体有Rg(1,2)血型抗体表型。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "A rare defect of the complement classical pathway associated with the development of autoimmune disorders, mainly systemic lupus with or without associated glomerulonephritis.(Source:OMIM)<br>The blood groups Chido (Ch) and Rodgers (Rg) are epitopes on the C4 protein, and polymorphisms associated with these epitopes may lead to the formation of antibodies to the Ch or Rg antigens in transfused patients. Identification of anti-Ch or anti-Rg is based on antibody neutralization with plasma from Ch-positive or Rg-positive individuals and lack of reactivity with qualified Ch-negative or Rg-negative red blood cells. The C4 protein occurs in 2 forms, C4A and C4B, which are encoded by 2 closely linked genes. C4A and C4B are expressed as single-chain precursors of 1,744 amino acids that are nearly identical, with amino acids differences at residues 1101 to 1106 distinguishing C4A from C4B. C4A and C4B are also distinguished by their expression of either the Ch antigen or the Rg antigen at residues 1188 to 1191, where the Ch1 epitope has ADLR and the Rg1 epitope has VDLL. C4A proteins usually carry the Rg antigens, and C4B proteins usually carry the Ch antigens, although in some haplotypes these associations are switched.             "generalizationEn": "21-hydroxylase deficiency (21-OHD) is the most common cause of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH), a family of autosomal recessive disorders involving impaired synthesis of cortisol from cholesterol by the adrenal cortex.             "generalizationCn": "结节病1型是结节病易感型的一种亚型。结节病易感型是一种原发性系统免疫疾病。主要临床表现为在器官中形成免疫芽肿，肉芽肿主要侵入肺和淋巴系统，但也可能涉及肝脏、脾脏、皮肤、眼睛和其他器官。该病患者存在持续性干咳、眼睛或皮肤表现、周围淋巴结肿大、疲劳、体重减轻、发热、盗汗及结节性红斑等症状。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>多发性硬化症1型是多发性硬化症的一种亚型。多发性硬化症是一种多因素、炎症性的中枢神经系统脱髓鞘病。硬化病变的特征是血管周围可见单核细胞和淋巴细胞浸润，在病理标本中显现为硬结区域（硬化斑块）。病理机制被认为是由细胞和体液免疫介导的髓鞘自身免疫性攻击。临床表现包括视力丧失、眼外肌运动障碍、感觉异常、感觉丧失、虚弱、构音困难、痉挛、共济失调和膀胱功能障碍。遗传和环境因素都会影响对疾病的易感性。（参考来源：OMIM）",
            "generalizationEn": "An idiopathic, systemic, inflammatory disease characterized by the formation of immune granulomas in involved organs. Granulomas predominantly invade the lungs and the lymphatic system, but also skin, liver, spleen, eyes and other organs may be involved. In most cases, sarcoidosis is revealed by persistent dry cough, eye or skin manifestations, peripheral lymph nodes, fatigue, weight loss, fever or night sweats, and erythema nodosum.(Source:OMIM)<br>A multifactorial, inflammatory, demyelinating disease of the central nervous system. Sclerotic lesions are characterized by perivascular infiltration of monocytes and lymphocytes and appear as indurated areas in pathologic specimens (sclerosis in plaques). The pathological mechanism is regarded as an autoimmune attack of the myelin sheath, mediated by both cellular and humoral immunity. Clinical manifestations include visual loss, extra-ocular movement disorders, paresthesias, loss of sensation, weakness, dysarthria, spasticity, ataxia and bladder dysfunction. Genetic and environmental factors influence susceptibility to the disease.(Source:OMIM)",

            "areaPicturePath": "NA;NA;pipeline/publish/job-pipeline_WGS_CLINICAL-240403173503-14363876/ali-test-sz1-sycamore-test-WGS_CLINICAL-20240511702031870000003/output/24X040300010/CNV/ExonDepth/filter/chr7-5977390-6018327.html",

            "binEnd": 71779,

            "chr": "chr7",
            "chrCoord": "chr7:5977390-6018327",
            "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"PMS2\", \"transcript\": \"NM_000535.5\", \"exon\": \"EX13-EX15E\", \"effecttype\": \"duplication\", \"chr\": \"7\", \"start\": \"5977390\", \"stop\": \"6018327\", \"primer\": \"PMS2;NM_000535.5;EX13-EX15E DUP;-;EX13-EX15E;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"600259\", \"location\": \"7p22.1\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"遗传性非息肉性结直肠癌4型\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Hereditary Nonpolyposis Colorectal cancer type 4\", \"generalizationCn\": \"遗传性非息肉性结直肠癌4型是一种常染色体显性遗传疾病，属于遗传性非息肉性结直肠癌（HNPCC）的一种类型。HNPCC可分为两种亚组:1）Lynch综合征I，又名位点特异性结肠癌；2）Lynch综合征II或肠外肿瘤，尤其是胃癌、子宫内膜癌、胆胰系统和泌尿系统癌。HNPCC特点为具有早发倾向、显著的结肠癌近端位置、显性遗传模式、多原发癌过剩、与美国外科医师学会系列同阶段相比存活率显著提高。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer (HNPCC) is subdivided into (1) Lynch syndrome I, or site-specific colonic cancer, and (2) Lynch syndrome II, or extracolonic cancer, particularly carcinoma of the stomach, endometrium (see 608089), biliary and pancreatic system, and urinary tract (Lynch and Lynch, 1979; Lynch et al., 1985; Mecklin and Jarvinen, 1991). HNPCC disorders show a proclivity to early onset, predominant proximal location of colon cancer, a dominant pattern of inheritance, an excess of multiple primary cancers, and significantly improved survival when compared stage for stage with the American College of Surgeons Audit Series.(Source:OMIM)\", \"omimDiseaseId\": \"614337\", \"omimGeneId\": \"600259\", \"systemSort\": \"ACMG、消化系统疾病、癌与肿瘤综合征\", \"heredityModel\": \"AD\", \"reference\": \"OMIM\", \"omimSynopsis\": \"暂无\", \"ageOnset\": \"成年期\"}, {\"diseaseCnName\": \"透克氏症\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Turcot Syndrome\", \"generalizationCn\": \"Turcot综合征是家族性腺瘤性息肉病的一种，同时伴有中枢神经系统瘤。家族性腺瘤性息肉病是一种遗传性疾病，临床主要特点为遗传性大肠/直肠癌。典型性家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者刚开始可能会于青少年期在结肠上出现多个息肉瘤，如果这些息肉瘤没有手术摘除将会癌化。典型性家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者发生结肠癌的平均年龄为39岁。非典型性的患者发病年龄可能会延迟至55岁。患者如果发生20个以上的腺瘤性息肉或腺瘤太大或有进展性组织学特征则应行结肠切除术。家族性腺瘤性息肉病发病率约为1:7000至1:22000，透克氏症发病率未知。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Turcot syndrome is the association of colonic polyposis typical of Familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) and central nervous system (CNS) tumors. FAP is an inherited disorder characterized by cancer of the large intestine (colon) and rectum. People with the classic type of familial adenomatous polyposis may begin to develop multiple noncancerous (benign) growths (polyps) in the colon as early as their teenage years. Unless the colon is removed, these polyps will become malignant (cancerous). The average age at which an individual develops colon cancer in classic familial adenomatous polyposis is 39 years. Some people have a variant of the disorder, called attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis, in which polyp growth is delayed. The average age of colorectal cancer onset for attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis is 55 years.             "generalizationCn": "遗传性非息肉性结直肠癌4型是一种常染色体显性遗传疾病，属于遗传性非息肉性结直肠癌（HNPCC）的一种类型。HNPCC可分为两种亚组:1）Lynch综合征I，又名位点特异性结肠癌；2）Lynch综合征II或肠外肿瘤，尤其是胃癌、子宫内膜癌、胆胰系统和泌尿系统癌。HNPCC特点为具有早发倾向、显著的结肠癌近端位置、显性遗传模式、多原发癌过剩、与美国外科医师学会系列同阶段相比存活率显著提高。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>Turcot综合征是家族性腺瘤性息肉病的一种，同时伴有中枢神经系统瘤。家族性腺瘤性息肉病是一种遗传性疾病，临床主要特点为遗传性大肠/直肠癌。典型性家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者刚开始可能会于青少年期在结肠上出现多个息肉瘤，如果这些息肉瘤没有手术摘除将会癌化。典型性家族性腺瘤性息肉病患者发生结肠癌的平均年龄为39岁。非典型性的患者发病年龄可能会延迟至55岁。患者如果发生20个以上的腺瘤性息肉或腺瘤太大或有进展性组织学特征则应行结肠切除术。家族性腺瘤性息肉病发病率约为1:7000至1:22000，透克氏症发病率未知。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>错配修复癌症综合征4型（MMRCS4）是一种常染色体隐性儿童期癌症易感综合征，其特征是早发性白血病/淋巴瘤、脑瘤、结直肠/胃肠道癌以及其他罕见的恶性肿瘤，包括横纹肌肉瘤。通常会出现牛奶咖啡斑。（参考来源：OMIM）<br>双侧侧脑室枕角扩张（参考来源：PMID22692065）",
            "generalizationEn": "Hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer (HNPCC) is subdivided into (1) Lynch syndrome I, or site-specific colonic cancer, and (2) Lynch syndrome II, or extracolonic cancer, particularly carcinoma of the stomach, endometrium (see 608089), biliary and pancreatic system, and urinary tract (Lynch and Lynch, 1979; Lynch et al., 1985; Mecklin and Jarvinen, 1991). HNPCC disorders show a proclivity to early onset, predominant proximal location of colon cancer, a dominant pattern of inheritance, an excess of multiple primary cancers, and significantly improved survival when compared stage for stage with the American College of Surgeons Audit Series.(Source:OMIM)<br>Turcot syndrome is the association of colonic polyposis typical of Familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) and central nervous system (CNS) tumors. FAP is an inherited disorder characterized by cancer of the large intestine (colon) and rectum. People with the classic type of familial adenomatous polyposis may begin to develop multiple noncancerous (benign) growths (polyps) in the colon as early as their teenage years. Unless the colon is removed, these polyps will become malignant (cancerous). The average age at which an individual develops colon cancer in classic familial adenomatous polyposis is 39 years. Some people have a variant of the disorder, called attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis, in which polyp growth is delayed. The average age of colorectal cancer onset for attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis is 55 years. Colectomy is recommended when greater than 20 adenomatous polyps are present, or when adenomas are large and/or have advanced histology. Most patients have mild to moderately impaired intellectual development and behavioral abnormalities, including aggression, hyperactivity, and autism spectrum disorder.             "cnvAnnot": "[{\"omimGene\": \"SERPINA1\", \"transcript\": \"NM_000295.4\", \"exon\": \"EX5E\", \"effecttype\": \"deletion\", \"chr\": \"14\", \"start\": \"94830101\", \"stop\": \"94845081\", \"primer\": \"SERPINA1;NM_000295.4;EX5E DEL;-;EX5E;-;-;-;-;-;-;-;-\", \"omimGeneId\": \"107400\", \"location\": \"14q32.13\", \"omimDiseases\": [{\"diseaseCnName\": \"α1抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症\", \"diseaseEnName\": \"Alpha1-Antitrypsin Deficiency\", \"generalizationCn\": \"α1抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症（AATD）的临床特征是成年人患慢性阻塞性肺疾病（例如肺气肿、持续的气流阻塞或慢性支气管炎）的风险增加，儿童和成年时期患肝脏疾病、脂膜炎和c-ANCA血管炎的风险增加。患者常表现为肺气肿、支气管扩张。肺气肿在儿童AATD患者中极其罕见，只有一小部分儿童患者患有AATD相关的肝病，在出生几个月时表现为阻塞性黄疸和增加血清转氨酶水平。肝脏疾病的发病率随着年龄的增长而增加。AATD患者患肝细胞癌（HCC）的风险增加。慢性阻塞性肺病患者采用标准治疗法。气流阻塞患者建议采用静脉增强疗法。肺部疾病晚期患者需要肺移植。脂肪炎的疼痛结节病变可能自行消退，也可能在服用大黄素或多西环素治疗后消退，当对常规治疗无反应时，脂肪炎已经对高于常规剂量的静脉增强疗法有反应。发病率为1/1,500-1/3,500（欧洲）。（参考来源：OMIM）\", \"generalizationEn\": \"Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD) is characterized by an increased risk for: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (i.e., emphysema, persistent airflow obstruction, and/or chronic bronchitis) in adults; liver disease in children and adults; panniculitis ; and c-ANCA positive vasculitis. Emphysema, sometimes with associated bronchiectasis, is the most common manifestation of AATD.Although reported, emphysema in children with AATD is extremely rare. AATD-associated liver disease, which is present in only a small portion of affected children, manifests as obstructive jaundice and increased serum aminotransferase levels in the early days and months of life. The incidence of liver disease increases with age.The risk for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is increased in individuals with AATD. Treatment of manifestations: COPD is treated with standard therapy. Intravenous augmentation therapy (regular infusion of purified human AAT to elevate deficient serum AAT concentrations) has been recommended for individuals with established fixed airflow obstruction. Lung transplantation may be an appropriate option for individuals with end-stage lung disease. Liver transplantation is the definitive treatment for advanced liver disease. The often painful nodular lesions of panniculitis may resolve spontaneously or after dapsone or doxycycline therapy. When refractory to conventional treatment, panniculitis has responded to intravenous AAT augmentation therapy in higher than conventional doses.Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency occurs worldwide, but its prevalence varies by population.
